title:PvE Podcast 175 - The Best Auto Rifles
description:Monument of Triumph new and reprised machine guns, based on trait perk discussions between @Saint_Kabr, @ImpetusAlways and @CourtProjects in the 14 July 2026 @PodvsEnemies podcast (https://open.spotify.com/episode/2C0LMcmUBtjwBWtOnjmrnX). Destiny Data Compendium, Aegis's Endgame Analysis Spreadsheet​ and other resources, available at https://www.destiny2.science/, or through https://www.youtube.com/@TheAegisRelic. The effect of weapon perks on stats can be found at https://destiny.report or https://d2foundry.gg 

// Snipehunt Mk.47 - PvE Minor god 1
// (Arrowhead Brake, Chambered Compensator, Extended Barrel, Fluted Barrel, Corkscrew Rifling, Polygonal Rifling, Smallbore, Hammer-Forged Rifling), (High-Caliber Rounds, Armor-Piercing Rounds, Ricochet Rounds, Appended Mag, Alloy Mag, Flared Magwell, Light Mag), (Jolting Feedback), (Gear Shift, Chaos Reshaped, Rolling Storm, Voltshot, Attrition Orbs)
//notes:Constructed by @Adamsdown_Boy (PvE PvE-Minor PvE-SingleAdd PvE-EndGame PvE-God Arc-Build M+KB Controller): First-choice PvE roll for clearing individual Minor adds or tougher enemies in activities rated Normal, Hard or Very Hard difficulty, particularly with Arc builds. Snipehunt Mk.47 is a lightweight auto rifle, which are rated C-Tier for endgame PvE by @TheAegisRelic Endgame Analysis Spreadsheet​, who says "solid damage profile but a strict step down compared to adaptive in same range tier". The frame intrinsic offers built-in anti-Overload, and +20 to the hidden Mobility stat and ×1.0625 base movement speed as per the Destiny Data Compendium. The recoil direction is left of vertical and very loose so you could improve Recoil Direction or look to boost Stability with the barrel perk to help hit crits, or Handling if you can land your shots. In the magazine perk slot, the combat effect perks work well, or look for perks that improve mag size or Reload Speed. For Arc builds, there's the opportunity for double damage perks with Jolting Feedback in the first trait perk column applying Arc Jolt after 14 hits (11 when amplified) to tougher enemies who can survive the weapon damage, triggering chain lightning on further hits for both target and AoE damage. In the second column, for straight damage, you can pair that with Gear Shift which stacks up to ×5 on reloads after kills or becoming Amplified for a refreshable 15s, granting up to a max ×1.35 damage boost, or Chaos Reshaped which stacks up to ×2 on dealing or receiving damage within a 5s window for at least 11.5s - at ×1 it provides a ×1.2 damage boost for a refreshable 7s and then at ×2 provides ×1.35 damage for a refreshable 7s together with a healing burst of up to 35HP that also starts health regeneration - although this is bugged, so while it's active if interrupts natural recovery and prevents regenerating the final 20-25% of your health bar. For additional arc splash damage, Rolling Storm generates ×1 stack of Arc Bolt Charge (×2 when Amplified) on a kill, to trigger a lightning bolt at ×10 stacks for both target and AoE damage, or Voltshot applies Arc Jolt to the next target you hit within 8s, after a reload within 5.3s of a kill, for additional damage to the target on further hits plus AoE chain lightning damage on nearby enemies. Or for utility, Attrition Orbs spawns a power orb after ~27 hits within 5s of each other to proc armour mods. Aegis ranks the Tex Balanced Stock origin trait as B-Tier for PvE - this procs a refreshable, mainly PvP focused buff after hitting 4 hip-fire shots within 4s of each other, which boosts Range, Handling and Reload Speed by +20 with a ×0.9 animation scalar, +1.5° Hip-fire precision angle threshold, better ADS speed, but also for PvE grants +35% stagger force. There's also the E-Tier Featherweight which stacks up to ×10 to improve movement speed. If you're interested, the name references a practical joke where beginners are led into the wilderness on a fabricated mission to hunt a non-existent bird. Recommended MW: Handling or Stability, with your preferred choice of mod to boost weapon stats, ammo generation, or elemental pickups for builds. |tags:PvE PvE-Minor PvE-SingleAdd PvE-EndGame Arc-Build PvE-God M+KB Controller

// Snipehunt Mk.47 - PvE Minor god 2
// (Arrowhead Brake, Chambered Compensator, Extended Barrel, Fluted Barrel, Corkscrew Rifling, Polygonal Rifling, Smallbore, Hammer-Forged Rifling), (High-Caliber Rounds, Armor-Piercing Rounds, Ricochet Rounds, Appended Mag, Alloy Mag, Flared Magwell, Light Mag), (Supercharged Magazine, Subsistence, Trickle Charge), (Gear Shift, Chaos Reshaped, Rolling Storm, Attrition Orbs)
//notes:Constructed by @Adamsdown_Boy (PvE PvE-Minor PvE-SingleAdd PvE-EndGame PvE-God Arc-Build M+KB Controller): First-choice PvE roll for clearing individual Minor adds or tougher enemies in activities rated Normal, Hard or Very Hard difficulty, particularly with Arc builds. Snipehunt Mk.47 is a lightweight auto rifle, which are rated C-Tier for endgame PvE by @TheAegisRelic Endgame Analysis Spreadsheet​, who says "solid damage profile but a strict step down compared to adaptive in same range tier". The frame intrinsic offers built-in anti-Overload, and +20 to the hidden Mobility stat and ×1.0625 base movement speed as per the Destiny Data Compendium. The recoil direction is left of vertical and very loose so you could improve Recoil Direction or look to boost Stability with the barrel perk to help hit crits, or Handling if you can land your shots. In the magazine perk slot, the combat effect perks work well, or look for perks that improve mag size or Reload Speed. For Arc builds, in the first trait perk column, to delay reloads you could look at Supercharged Magazine which refills 5% of the magazine every 1.5s while you're Amplified or, after you sprint when Amplified to gain Speed Booster this accelerates to 5% every 0.25s while the buff is active, overflowing the magazine to up to ×2 capacity, or Trickle Charge which refills 10% of the magazine on receiving a stack of Arc Bolt Charge, and 20% when you discharge with a lightning bolt on a target. Alternatively, Subsistence reloads 20% of the magazine on kills. In the second column, for straight damage, you can pair that with Gear Shift which stacks up to ×5 on reloads after kills or becoming Amplified for a refreshable 15s, granting up to a max ×1.35 damage boost, or Chaos Reshaped which stacks up to ×2 on dealing or receiving damage within a 5s window for at least 11.5s - at ×1 it provides a ×1.2 damage boost for a refreshable 7s and then at ×2 provides ×1.35 damage for a refreshable 7s together with a healing burst of up to 35HP that also starts health regeneration - although this is bugged, so while it's active if interrupts natural recovery and prevents regenerating the final 20-25% of your health bar. Arc splash damage Rolling Storm generates ×1 stack of Arc Bolt Charge (×2 when Amplified) on a kill, to trigger a lightning bolt at ×10 stacks for both target and AoE damage. Or for utility, Attrition Orbs spawns a power orb after ~27 hits within 5s of each other to proc armour mods. Aegis ranks the Tex Balanced Stock origin trait as B-Tier for PvE - this procs a refreshable, mainly PvP focused buff after hitting 4 hip-fire shots within 4s of each other, which boosts Range, Handling and Reload Speed by +20 with a ×0.9 animation scalar, +1.5° Hip-fire precision angle threshold, better ADS speed, but also for PvE grants +35% stagger force. There's also the E-Tier Featherweight which stacks up to ×10 to improve movement speed. If you're interested, the name references a practical joke where beginners are led into the wilderness on a fabricated mission to hunt a non-existent bird. Recommended MW: Handling or Stability, with your preferred choice of mod to boost weapon stats, ammo generation, or elemental pickups for builds. |tags:PvE PvE-Minor PvE-SingleAdd PvE-EndGame Arc-Build PvE-God M+KB Controller

// Snipehunt Mk.47 - PvE Minor god 1
// (Arrowhead Brake, Chambered Compensator, Extended Barrel, Fluted Barrel, Corkscrew Rifling, Polygonal Rifling, Smallbore, Hammer-Forged Rifling), (High-Caliber Rounds, Armor-Piercing Rounds, Ricochet Rounds, Appended Mag, Alloy Mag, Flared Magwell, Light Mag), (Jolting Feedback), (Gear Shift, Chaos Reshaped, Rolling Storm, Voltshot, Attrition Orbs)
//notes:Constructed by @Adamsdown_Boy (PvE PvE-Minor PvE-SingleAdd PvE-EndGame PvE-God Arc-Build M+KB Controller): First-choice PvE roll for clearing individual Minor adds or tougher enemies in activities rated Normal, Hard or Very Hard difficulty, particularly with Arc builds. Snipehunt Mk.47 is a lightweight auto rifle, which are rated C-Tier for endgame PvE by @TheAegisRelic Endgame Analysis Spreadsheet​, who says "solid damage profile but a strict step down compared to adaptive in same range tier". The frame intrinsic offers built-in anti-Overload, and +20 to the hidden Mobility stat and ×1.0625 base movement speed as per the Destiny Data Compendium. The recoil direction is left of vertical and very loose so you could improve Recoil Direction or look to boost Stability with the barrel perk to help hit crits, or Handling if you can land your shots. In the magazine perk slot, the combat effect perks work well, or look for perks that improve mag size or Reload Speed. For Arc builds, there's the opportunity for double damage perks with Jolting Feedback in the first trait perk column applying Arc Jolt after 14 hits (11 when amplified) to tougher enemies who can survive the weapon damage, triggering chain lightning on further hits for both target and AoE damage. In the second column, for straight damage, you can pair that with Gear Shift which stacks up to ×5 on reloads after kills or becoming Amplified for a refreshable 15s, granting up to a max ×1.35 damage boost, or Chaos Reshaped which stacks up to ×2 on dealing or receiving damage within a 5s window for at least 11.5s - at ×1 it provides a ×1.2 damage boost for a refreshable 7s and then at ×2 provides ×1.35 damage for a refreshable 7s together with a healing burst of up to 35HP that also starts health regeneration - although this is bugged, so while it's active if interrupts natural recovery and prevents regenerating the final 20-25% of your health bar. For additional arc splash damage, Rolling Storm generates ×1 stack of Arc Bolt Charge (×2 when Amplified) on a kill, to trigger a lightning bolt at ×10 stacks for both target and AoE damage, or Voltshot applies Arc Jolt to the next target you hit within 8s, after a reload within 5.3s of a kill, for additional damage to the target on further hits plus AoE chain lightning damage on nearby enemies. Or for utility, Attrition Orbs spawns a power orb after ~27 hits within 5s of each other to proc armour mods. Aegis ranks the Tex Balanced Stock origin trait as B-Tier for PvE - this procs a refreshable, mainly PvP focused buff after hitting 4 hip-fire shots within 4s of each other, which boosts Range, Handling and Reload Speed by +20 with a ×0.9 animation scalar, +1.5° Hip-fire precision angle threshold, better ADS speed, but also for PvE grants +35% stagger force. There's also the E-Tier Featherweight which stacks up to ×10 to improve movement speed. If you're interested, the name references a practical joke where beginners are led into the wilderness on a fabricated mission to hunt a non-existent bird. Recommended MW: Handling or Stability, with your preferred choice of mod to boost weapon stats, ammo generation, or elemental pickups for builds. |tags:PvE PvE-Minor PvE-SingleAdd PvE-EndGame Arc-Build PvE-God M+KB Controller

// (Arrowhead Brake, Chambered Compensator, Extended Barrel, Fluted Barrel, Corkscrew Rifling, Polygonal Rifling, Smallbore, Hammer-Forged Rifling), (High-Caliber Rounds, Armor-Piercing Rounds, Ricochet Rounds, Appended Mag, Alloy Mag, Flared Magwell, Light Mag), (Supercharged Magazine, Subsistence, Trickle Charge), (Gear Shift, Chaos Reshaped, Rolling Storm, Attrition Orbs)
//notes:Constructed by @Adamsdown_Boy (PvE PvE-Minor PvE-SingleAdd PvE-EndGame PvE-God Arc-Build M+KB Controller): First-choice PvE roll for clearing individual Minor adds or tougher enemies in activities rated Normal, Hard or Very Hard difficulty, particularly with Arc builds. Snipehunt Mk.47 is a lightweight auto rifle, which are rated C-Tier for endgame PvE by @TheAegisRelic Endgame Analysis Spreadsheet​, who says "solid damage profile but a strict step down compared to adaptive in same range tier". The frame intrinsic offers built-in anti-Overload, and +20 to the hidden Mobility stat and ×1.0625 base movement speed as per the Destiny Data Compendium. The recoil direction is left of vertical and very loose so you could improve Recoil Direction or look to boost Stability with the barrel perk to help hit crits, or Handling if you can land your shots. In the magazine perk slot, the combat effect perks work well, or look for perks that improve mag size or Reload Speed. For Arc builds, in the first trait perk column, to delay reloads you could look at Supercharged Magazine which refills 5% of the magazine every 1.5s while you're Amplified or, after you sprint when Amplified to gain Speed Booster this accelerates to 5% every 0.25s while the buff is active, overflowing the magazine to up to ×2 capacity, or Trickle Charge which refills 10% of the magazine on receiving a stack of Arc Bolt Charge, and 20% when you discharge with a lightning bolt on a target. Alternatively, Subsistence reloads 20% of the magazine on kills. In the second column, for straight damage, you can pair that with Gear Shift which stacks up to ×5 on reloads after kills or becoming Amplified for a refreshable 15s, granting up to a max ×1.35 damage boost, or Chaos Reshaped which stacks up to ×2 on dealing or receiving damage within a 5s window for at least 11.5s - at ×1 it provides a ×1.2 damage boost for a refreshable 7s and then at ×2 provides ×1.35 damage for a refreshable 7s together with a healing burst of up to 35HP that also starts health regeneration - although this is bugged, so while it's active if interrupts natural recovery and prevents regenerating the final 20-25% of your health bar. Arc splash damage Rolling Storm generates ×1 stack of Arc Bolt Charge (×2 when Amplified) on a kill, to trigger a lightning bolt at ×10 stacks for both target and AoE damage. Or for utility, Attrition Orbs spawns a power orb after ~27 hits within 5s of each other to proc armour mods. Aegis ranks the Tex Balanced Stock origin trait as B-Tier for PvE - this procs a refreshable, mainly PvP focused buff after hitting 4 hip-fire shots within 4s of each other, which boosts Range, Handling and Reload Speed by +20 with a ×0.9 animation scalar, +1.5° Hip-fire precision angle threshold, better ADS speed, but also for PvE grants +35% stagger force. There's also the E-Tier Featherweight which stacks up to ×10 to improve movement speed. If you're interested, the name references a practical joke where beginners are led into the wilderness on a fabricated mission to hunt a non-existent bird. Recommended MW: Handling or Stability, with your preferred choice of mod to boost weapon stats, ammo generation, or elemental pickups for builds. |tags:PvE PvE-Minor PvE-SingleAdd PvE-EndGame Arc-Build PvE-God M+KB Controller

// Age-Old Bond - PvE Minor god 1
// (Arrowhead Brake, Chambered Compensator, Extended Barrel, Polygonal Rifling, Smallbore, Fluted Barrel, Corkscrew Rifling), (Flared Magwell, Tactical Mag, Appended Mag, Alloy Mag), (Meganeura), (Destabilizing Rounds)
//notes:Constructed by @Adamsdown_Boy (PvE PvE-Minor PvE-GroupAdd PvE-EndGame PvE-God Void-Build M+KB Controller): First-choice PvE roll for clearing groups of Minor adds in activities rated Normal, Hard or Very Hard difficulty, particularly with Void builds. Age-Old Bond is a high-impact auto rifle, which are rated B-Tier for endgame PvE by @TheAegisRelic Endgame Analysis Spreadsheet​, who says "range outlier with good stagger access, 2nd best damage profile despite low fire rate". The frame intrinsic offers built in Anti-Unstoppable, and ×0.8 accuracy cone size and ×0.83 accuracy cone growth when moving 2.8m/s or less (crouch walking speed) as per the Destiny Data Compendium. The recoil direction is right of vertical but tight and for this roll you need to use the barrel perk to control recoil to help hit crits so you could take the Recoil Direction to 100 or look to boost Stability to help hit crits, or Handling if you can land your shots. In the magazine perk slot, look for perks that improve Stability, mag size or Reload Speed. If you like watching Minor adds explode into purple mist, in the first trait perk column Meganeura builds up to ×3 stacks on crit hits for a refreshable 4s for Void AoE explosion in a 7.5m radius on a crit kill - the AoE damage scales with the number of stacks and is treated as weapon damage so inherits damage boosts and also procs subclass fragments. In the second column, Destabilizing Rounds spreads Void Volatility on a kill in a 6.5m radius and provides Volatile Rounds for 5.25s. When you get a precision kill, both perks activate simultaneously. The Meganeura damage will instantly detonate the Volatile status on any surviving minor adds, resulting in a chain reaction of secondary Void explosions. Aegis ranks the Explosive Pact origin trait as D-Tier for PvE - it stacks up to ×5 on grenade ability use to boost Stability and Reload Speed for 7.5s. If you're interested, the name refers to the metaphysical, symbiotic relationship forged between a Guardian and an Ahamkara. Recommended MW: Stability, with your preferred choice of mod to boost weapon stats, ammo generation, or elemental pickups for builds. |tags:PvE PvE-Minor PvE-GroupAdd PvE-EndGame PvE-God Void-Build M+KB Controller

// Rufus's Fury - PvE Minor god 1
// (Arrowhead Brake, Chambered Compensator, Extended Barrel, Fluted Barrel, Corkscrew Rifling, Polygonal Rifling, Smallbore, Hammer-Forged Rifling), (High-Caliber Rounds, Armor-Piercing Rounds, Ricochet Rounds, Appended Mag, Alloy Mag, Flared Magwell, Light Mag), (Slice), (Chaos Reshaped, Frenzy)
//notes:Constructed by @Adamsdown_Boy (PvE PvE-Minor PvE-SingleAdd PvE-EndGame PvE-God Strand-Build M+KB Controller): First-choice PvE roll for clearing individual Minor adds or tougher enemies in activities rated Normal, Hard or Very Hard difficulty, particularly with Strand builds. Rufus's Fury is a rapid-fire auto rifle, which are rated C-Tier for endgame PvE by @TheAegisRelic Endgame Analysis Spreadsheet​, who says "solid damage profile but a strict step down compared to adaptive in same range tier". The frame intrinsic offers built in Anti-Overload, better total ammo reserves and a ×0.8 reload animation scalar when the magazine is empty as per the Destiny Data Compendium. The recoil direction is just right of vertical and very loose so you could improve Recoil Direction or look to boost Stability with the barrel perk to help hit crits, or Handling if you can land your shots. In the magazine perk slot, the combat effect perks work well, or look for perks that improve mag size or Reload Speed. For Strand builds, in the first trait perk column Slice procs for 9s after using a class ability, to Sever up to 5 enemies for ×0.6 damage reduction for a refreshable 10s. In the second column for damage, Chaos Reshaped stacks up to ×2 on dealing or receiving damage within a 5s window for at least 11.5s - at ×1 it provides a ×1.2 damage boost for a refreshable 7s and then at ×2 provides ×1.35 damage for a refreshable 7s together with a healing burst of up to 35HP that also starts health regeneration - although this is bugged, so while it's active if interrupts natural recovery and prevents regenerating the final 20-25% of your health bar. If you don't have other ways of recovering health through subclass aspects then Frenzy, after being in combat for 12s - that's dealing or taking damage - boosts Handling and Reload Speed by +100 and boosts damage by ×1.15 for a refreshable 7.2s. Aegis ranks the Harmonic Resonance origin trait as C-Tier for PvE - it boosts Handling and Reload Speed, and damage by up to a max ×1.1 against Dread and Lucent Hive Lightbearers for equipping other Root of Nightmares weapons. If you're interested, Rufus stems from the Latin word for "red" or "red-haired", which is possibly a thematic nod to the crimson-hued, Nightmare-infused aesthetics of Nezarec’s domain, while in-game lore establishes Rufus as one of his Acolytes. Recommended MW: Handling or Stability, with your preferred choice of mod to boost weapon stats, ammo generation, or elemental pickups for builds. |tags:PvE PvE-Minor PvE-GroupAdd PvE-EndGame PvE-God Strand-Build M+KB Controller

// Rufus's Fury - PvE Minor god 2
// (Arrowhead Brake, Chambered Compensator, Extended Barrel, Fluted Barrel, Corkscrew Rifling, Polygonal Rifling, Smallbore, Hammer-Forged Rifling), (High-Caliber Rounds, Armor-Piercing Rounds, Ricochet Rounds, Appended Mag, Alloy Mag, Flared Magwell, Light Mag), (Rewind Rounds), (Chaos Reshaped, Frenzy)
//notes:Constructed by @Adamsdown_Boy (PvE PvE-Minor PvE-SingleAdd PvE-EndGame PvE-God M+KB Controller): First-choice PvE roll for clearing individual Minor adds or tougher enemies in activities rated Normal, Hard or Very Hard difficulty. Rufus's Fury is a rapid-fire auto rifle, which are rated C-Tier for endgame PvE by @TheAegisRelic Endgame Analysis Spreadsheet​, who says "solid damage profile but a strict step down compared to adaptive in same range tier". The frame intrinsic offers built in Anti-Overload, better total ammo reserves and a ×0.8 reload animation scalar when the magazine is empty as per the Destiny Data Compendium. The recoil direction is just right of vertical and very loose so you could improve Recoil Direction or look to boost Stability with the barrel perk to help hit crits, or Handling if you can land your shots. In the magazine perk slot, the combat effect perks work well, or look for perks that improve mag size or Reload Speed. For a general roll, in the first trait perk column, Rewind Rounds refills 70% of hits landed from reserves when the magazine empties. In the second column for damage, Chaos Reshaped stacks up to ×2 on dealing or receiving damage within a 5s window for at least 11.5s - at ×1 it provides a ×1.2 damage boost for a refreshable 7s and then at ×2 provides ×1.35 damage for a refreshable 7s together with a healing burst of up to 35HP that also starts health regeneration - although this is bugged, so while it's active if interrupts natural recovery and prevents regenerating the final 20-25% of your health bar. If you don't have other ways of recovering health through subclass aspects then Frenzy, after being in combat for 12s - that's dealing or taking damage - boosts Handling and Reload Speed by +100 and boosts damage by ×1.15 for a refreshable 7.2s. Aegis ranks the Harmonic Resonance origin trait as C-Tier for PvE - it boosts Handling and Reload Speed, and damage by up to a max ×1.1 against Dread and Lucent Hive Lightbearers for equipping other Root of Nightmares weapons. If you're interested, Rufus stems from the Latin word for "red" or "red-haired", which is possibly a thematic nod to the crimson-hued, Nightmare-infused aesthetics of Nezarec’s domain, while in-game lore establishes Rufus as one of his Acolytes. Recommended MW: Handling or Stability, with your preferred choice of mod to boost weapon stats, ammo generation, or elemental pickups for builds. |tags:PvE PvE-Minor PvE-GroupAdd PvE-EndGame PvE-God M+KB Controller

// Rufus's Fury (Adept) - PvE Minor god 1
// (Arrowhead Brake, Chambered Compensator, Extended Barrel, Fluted Barrel, Corkscrew Rifling, Polygonal Rifling, Smallbore, Hammer-Forged Rifling), (High-Caliber Rounds, Armor-Piercing Rounds, Ricochet Rounds, Appended Mag, Alloy Mag, Flared Magwell, Light Mag), (Slice), (Chaos Reshaped, Frenzy)
//notes:Constructed by @Adamsdown_Boy (PvE PvE-Minor PvE-SingleAdd PvE-EndGame PvE-God Strand-Build M+KB Controller): First-choice PvE roll for clearing individual Minor adds or tougher enemies in activities rated Normal, Hard or Very Hard difficulty, particularly with Strand builds. Rufus's Fury (Adept) is a rapid-fire auto rifle, which are rated C-Tier for endgame PvE by @TheAegisRelic Endgame Analysis Spreadsheet​, who says "solid damage profile but a strict step down compared to adaptive in same range tier". The frame intrinsic offers built in Anti-Overload, better total ammo reserves and a ×0.8 reload animation scalar when the magazine is empty as per the Destiny Data Compendium. The recoil direction is just right of vertical and very loose so you could improve Recoil Direction or look to boost Stability with the barrel perk to help hit crits, or Handling if you can land your shots. In the magazine perk slot, the combat effect perks work well, or look for perks that improve mag size or Reload Speed. For Strand builds, in the first trait perk column Slice procs for 9s after using a class ability, to Sever up to 5 enemies for ×0.6 damage reduction for a refreshable 10s. In the second column for damage, Chaos Reshaped stacks up to ×2 on dealing or receiving damage within a 5s window for at least 11.5s - at ×1 it provides a ×1.2 damage boost for a refreshable 7s and then at ×2 provides ×1.35 damage for a refreshable 7s together with a healing burst of up to 35HP that also starts health regeneration - although this is bugged, so while it's active if interrupts natural recovery and prevents regenerating the final 20-25% of your health bar. If you don't have other ways of recovering health through subclass aspects then Frenzy, after being in combat for 12s - that's dealing or taking damage - boosts Handling and Reload Speed by +100 and boosts damage by ×1.15 for a refreshable 7.2s. Aegis ranks the Harmonic Resonance origin trait as C-Tier for PvE - it boosts Handling and Reload Speed, and damage by up to a max ×1.1 against Dread and Lucent Hive Lightbearers for equipping other Root of Nightmares weapons. If you're interested, Rufus stems from the Latin word for "red" or "red-haired", which is possibly a thematic nod to the crimson-hued, Nightmare-infused aesthetics of Nezarec’s domain, while in-game lore establishes Rufus as one of his Acolytes. Recommended MW: Handling or Stability, with your preferred choice of mod to boost weapon stats, ammo generation, or elemental pickups for builds. |tags:PvE PvE-Minor PvE-GroupAdd PvE-EndGame PvE-God Strand-Build M+KB Controller

// Rufus's Fury (Adept) - PvE Minor god 2
// (Arrowhead Brake, Chambered Compensator, Extended Barrel, Fluted Barrel, Corkscrew Rifling, Polygonal Rifling, Smallbore, Hammer-Forged Rifling), (High-Caliber Rounds, Armor-Piercing Rounds, Ricochet Rounds, Appended Mag, Alloy Mag, Flared Magwell, Light Mag), (Rewind Rounds), (Chaos Reshaped, Frenzy)
//notes:Constructed by @Adamsdown_Boy (PvE PvE-Minor PvE-SingleAdd PvE-EndGame PvE-God M+KB Controller): First-choice PvE roll for clearing individual Minor adds or tougher enemies in activities rated Normal, Hard or Very Hard difficulty. Rufus's Fury (Adept) is a rapid-fire auto rifle, which are rated C-Tier for endgame PvE by @TheAegisRelic Endgame Analysis Spreadsheet​, who says "solid damage profile but a strict step down compared to adaptive in same range tier". The frame intrinsic offers built in Anti-Overload, better total ammo reserves and a ×0.8 reload animation scalar when the magazine is empty as per the Destiny Data Compendium. The recoil direction is just right of vertical and very loose so you could improve Recoil Direction or look to boost Stability with the barrel perk to help hit crits, or Handling if you can land your shots. In the magazine perk slot, the combat effect perks work well, or look for perks that improve mag size or Reload Speed. For a general roll, in the first trait perk column, Rewind Rounds refills 70% of hits landed from reserves when the magazine empties. In the second column for damage, Chaos Reshaped stacks up to ×2 on dealing or receiving damage within a 5s window for at least 11.5s - at ×1 it provides a ×1.2 damage boost for a refreshable 7s and then at ×2 provides ×1.35 damage for a refreshable 7s together with a healing burst of up to 35HP that also starts health regeneration - although this is bugged, so while it's active if interrupts natural recovery and prevents regenerating the final 20-25% of your health bar. If you don't have other ways of recovering health through subclass aspects then Frenzy, after being in combat for 12s - that's dealing or taking damage - boosts Handling and Reload Speed by +100 and boosts damage by ×1.15 for a refreshable 7.2s. Aegis ranks the Harmonic Resonance origin trait as C-Tier for PvE - it boosts Handling and Reload Speed, and damage by up to a max ×1.1 against Dread and Lucent Hive Lightbearers for equipping other Root of Nightmares weapons. If you're interested, Rufus stems from the Latin word for "red" or "red-haired", which is possibly a thematic nod to the crimson-hued, Nightmare-infused aesthetics of Nezarec’s domain, while in-game lore establishes Rufus as one of his Acolytes. Recommended MW: Handling or Stability, with your preferred choice of mod to boost weapon stats, ammo generation, or elemental pickups for builds. |tags:PvE PvE-Minor PvE-GroupAdd PvE-EndGame PvE-God M+KB Controller

// Adamantite - PvE Minor god 1
// (Full Bore, Hammer-Forged Rifling, Smallbore, Extended Barrel, Corkscrew Rifling), (Tactical Mag, Accurized Rounds, Appended Mag, Alloy Mag, Flared Magwell), (Reciprocity, Redirection, Physic), (Tear)
//notes:Constructed by @Adamsdown_Boy (PvE PvE-Utility PvE-Minor PvE-SingleAdd PvE-EndGame PvE-God Strand-Build M+KB Controller): First-choice PvE roll for clearing individual Minor adds or tougher enemies in activities rated Normal, Hard or Very Hard difficulty, particularly for Strand builds. Adamantite is a support-frame auto rifle, which are rated B-Tier for endgame PvE by @TheAegisRelic Endgame Analysis Spreadsheet​, who says "damage profile is serviceable, also has two niches in boosting damage and survivability". The frame intrinsic offers built in Anti-Overload, and it shoots tracking projectiles at enemies - any ability or weapon damage generates weapon energy that can be used when hipfiring at allies to heal them, with rapid healing propagating four Unravelling threads as per the Destiny Data Compendium - honestly, a bit disappointing if you were hoping for Woven Mail. On Support Frames, the Range stat determines how far your bullets will travel before vanishing, so look for that with the barrel perk. In the magazine perk slot, look for perks that improve Range, mag size or Reload Speed. In the first trait perk column, we've lost Slice in the reissued weapon, so we're left with Reciprocity which heals 3HP for each healing projectile that hits an ally or Redirection which stores damage by hitting red bar adds, for 2 stacks per hit up to 30 stacks, for use against orange and yellow bar enemies for ×1.5 damage at two stacks consumed per shot. For Strand synergy, there's also Physic which generates four Unravelling threads from both the user and ally, when the support frame boost is triggered. In the second column, Tear spreads ~4m AoE Strand Sever on a crit kill to reduce damage output to ×0.6 from enemies affected. Aegis ranks the Heretical Behavior origin trait as S-Tier for PvE - it's excellent for additional damage, proccing for a refreshable 8s after 4 hits within 10s, or for 23s after being revived, to boost damage by ×1.08, and Handling and Reload Speed by +50 with a ×0.8 reload animation scalar. There's also the C-Tier Willing Vessel, which generates up to ×5 stacks of a slowly decaying buff on dealing damage and kills, to boost Stability, Handling and Reload Speed. If you're interested, the name is derived from the Greek adamas, meaning "unconquerable" or "untamed", historically used to describe a mythologically unbreakable mineral. Recommended MW: Range, with your preferred choice of mod to boost weapon stats, ammo generation, or elemental pickups for builds. |tags:PvE PvE-Utility PvE-Minor PvE-SingleAdd PvE-EndGame PvE-God Strand-Build M+KB Controller

// Abyss Defiant - PvE Minor god 1
// (Fluted Barrel, Arrowhead Brake, Corkscrew Rifling, Polygonal Rifling, Smallbore, Hammer-Forged Rifling), (High-Caliber Rounds, Armor-Piercing Rounds, Ricochet Rounds, Appended Mag, Alloy Mag, Flared Magwell, Light Mag), (Burning Ambition), (Incandescent)
//notes:Constructed by @Adamsdown_Boy (PvE PvE-Minor PvE-GroupAdd PvE-EndGame PvE-God Solar-Build M+KB Controller): First-choice PvE roll for clearing groups of Minor adds in activities rated Normal, Hard or Very Hard difficulty, particularly with Solar builds. Abyss Defiant is a high-impact auto rifle, which are rated B-Tier for endgame PvE by @TheAegisRelic Endgame Analysis Spreadsheet​, who says "range outlier with good stagger access, 2nd best damage profile despite low fire rate". The frame intrinsic offers built in Anti-Unstoppable, and ×0.8 accuracy cone size and ×0.83 accuracy cone growth when moving 2.8m/s or less (crouch walking speed) as per the Destiny Data Compendium. The recoil direction is slightly left of vertical and tight so you can take your pick with the barrel perk to boost Handling, Stability or Range. In the magazine perk slot, the combat effect perks work well, or look for perks that improve mag size or Reload Speed. For a roll to clear both group and tougher individual adds, and which also synergises with Solar builds - you can use a scorch ability to make the most of Burning Ambition in the first trait perk column to build Solar ignitions on tougher targets. If you can't apply scorch first, it'll take ~28 hits within 2s of each other to apply +10 scorch stacks, with +10 added on each additional hit afterwards to build towards an ignition. In the second column, Incandescent spreads +30 Solar Scorch stacks within 4m on a red bar Minor add kill (+45 stacks within 8m for orange and yellow bars), with scorch damage counting as weapon damage so can inherit damage boosts, and also proc subclass fragments. All of the scorch stacks for both perks are increased by ×1.5 with Ember of Ashes. Aegis ranks the Cursed Thrall origin trait as A-Tier for PvE - it synergises well with melee builds - killing an enemy with a melee will proc a 4.5m radius Cursed Thrall AoE explosion for 8.5s on the next weapon kill. Recommended MW: Handling or Stability, with your preferred choice of mod to boost weapon stats, ammo generation, or elemental pickups for builds. |tags:PvE PvE-Minor PvE-GroupAdd PvE-EndGame Solar-Build PvE-God M+KB Controller

// Giver's Blessing - PvE Minor god 1
// (Arrowhead Brake, Chambered Compensator, Extended Barrel, Fluted Barrel, Corkscrew Rifling, Polygonal Rifling, Smallbore, Hammer-Forged Rifling), (High-Caliber Rounds, Armor-Piercing Rounds, Ricochet Rounds, Appended Mag, Alloy Mag, Flared Magwell, Light Mag), (Shoot to Loot, Rewind Rounds, Demolitionist, Rewind Rounds), (Kinetic Tremors)
//notes:Constructed by @Adamsdown_Boy (PvE PvE-Minor PvE-GroupAdd PvE-EndGame PvE-God M+KB Controller): First-choice PvE roll for clearing groups of Minor adds in activities rated Normal, Hard or Very Hard difficulty. Giver's Blessing is a rapid-fire auto rifle, which are rated C-Tier for endgame PvE by @TheAegisRelic Endgame Analysis Spreadsheet​, who says "solid damage profile but a strict step down compared to adaptive in same range tier". The frame intrinsic offers built in Anti-Overload, better total ammo reserves and a ×0.8 reload animation scalar when the magazine is empty as per the Destiny Data Compendium. The recoil direction is right of vertical and loose so you could improve Recoil Direction or look to boost Stability with the barrel perk to help hit crits, or Handling if you can land your shots. In the magazine perk slot, the combat effect perks work well, or look for perks that improve mag size or Reload Speed. For a general purpose AR that'll help with add groups, in the first trait perk column Shoot to Loot lets you pick up remote ammo bricks or orbs from safety by shooting them, which also reloads all your weapons from reserves or Rewind Rounds refills 70% of hits landed from reserves when the magazine empties. Alternatively, Demolitionist generates chunk grenade ability energy on kills and an instant magazine refill on grenade use. In the second column for damage, Kinetic Tremors emits three 6m AoE Kinetic shockwaves after 11 hits within 3s of each other, which are treated as weapon damage so inherit damage boosts and also proc weapon effects like picking up ammo bricks and power orbs with Shoot to Loot. Aegis ranks the Exhaustive Research origin trait as B-Tier for PvE - it loads a micro-missile when ADSing for 0.6s at a target within 60m, with a 5.5s cooldown. If you're interested, the lore tab tells of an Eliksni Archon that murders a Dreg after obsessing over an Eliksni named Levaszk, who allegedly discovered something "beyond Ether" and "beyond time" hidden within dark matter. The "Giver" refers to this enigmatic cosmic source, and the "blessing" represents an ominous transcendence or ascension achieved through this dark matter discovery. Recommended MW: Handling or Stability, with your preferred choice of mod to boost weapon stats, ammo generation, or elemental pickups for builds. |tags:PvE PvE-Minor PvE-GroupAdd PvE-EndGame PvE-God M+KB Controller

// Giver's Blessing - PvE Minor god 2
// (Arrowhead Brake, Chambered Compensator, Extended Barrel, Fluted Barrel, Corkscrew Rifling, Polygonal Rifling, Smallbore, Hammer-Forged Rifling), (High-Caliber Rounds, Armor-Piercing Rounds, Ricochet Rounds, Appended Mag, Alloy Mag, Flared Magwell, Light Mag), (Shoot to Loot, Rewind Rounds, Demolitionist, Rewind Rounds), (One For All)
//notes:Constructed by @Adamsdown_Boy (PvE PvE-Minor PvE-SingleAdd PvE-EndGame PvE-God M+KB Controller): First-choice PvE roll for clearing individual Minor adds or tougher enemies in activities rated Normal, Hard or Very Hard difficulty. Giver's Blessing is a rapid-fire auto rifle, which are rated C-Tier for endgame PvE by @TheAegisRelic Endgame Analysis Spreadsheet​, who says "solid damage profile but a strict step down compared to adaptive in same range tier". The frame intrinsic offers built in Anti-Overload, better total ammo reserves and a ×0.8 reload animation scalar when the magazine is empty as per the Destiny Data Compendium. The recoil direction is right of vertical and loose so you could improve Recoil Direction or look to boost Stability with the barrel perk to help hit crits, or Handling if you can land your shots. In the magazine perk slot, the combat effect perks work well, or look for perks that improve mag size or Reload Speed. For a general purpose AR that'll help with tougher adds, in the first trait perk column Shoot to Loot lets you pick up remote ammo bricks or orbs from safety by shooting them, which also reloads all your weapons from reserves or Rewind Rounds refills 70% of hits landed from reserves when the magazine empties. Alternatively, Demolitionist generates chunk grenade ability energy on kills and an instant magazine refill on grenade use. In the second column for damage, One For All boosts damage by ×1.35 for a non-refreshable 11s after hitting three separate targets within 3s of each. Aegis ranks the Exhaustive Research origin trait as B-Tier for PvE - it loads a micro-missile when ADSing for 0.6s at a target within 60m, with a 5.5s cooldown. If you're interested, the lore tab tells of an Eliksni Archon that murders a Dreg after obsessing over an Eliksni named Levaszk, who allegedly discovered something "beyond Ether" and "beyond time" hidden within dark matter. The "Giver" refers to this enigmatic cosmic source, and the "blessing" represents an ominous transcendence or ascension achieved through this dark matter discovery. Recommended MW: Handling or Stability, with your preferred choice of mod to boost weapon stats, ammo generation, or elemental pickups for builds. |tags:PvE PvE-Minor PvE-SingleAdd PvE-EndGame PvE-God M+KB Controller

// Prosecutor - PvE Minor god 1
// (Fluted Barrel, Arrowhead Brake, Corkscrew Rifling, Polygonal Rifling, Smallbore, Hammer-Forged Rifling), (High-Caliber Rounds, Armor-Piercing Rounds, Ricochet Rounds, Appended Mag, Alloy Mag, Flared Magwell, Light Mag), (Dragonfly), (Gear Shift, Rolling Storm, Voltshot)
//notes:Constructed by @Adamsdown_Boy (PvE PvE-Minor PvE-SingleAdd PvE-God Arc-Build M+KB Controller): First-choice PvE roll for clearing individual Minor adds or tougher enemies in activities rated Normal difficulty, particularly with Arc builds. Prosecutor is a precision auto rifle, which are rated C-Tier for endgame PvE by @TheAegisRelic Endgame Analysis Spreadsheet​, who says "worse damage profile than balanced, but has barrier intrinsic". The frame intrinsic offers built in Anti-Barrier, and a ×0.9 reduction in horizontal recoil, as per the Destiny Data Compendium. With the frame intrinsic, you don't really have to worry about Recoil Direction, so you can take your pick with the barrel perk to boost Handling, Stability or Range. In the magazine perk slot, the combat effect perks work well, or look for perks that improve mag size or Reload Speed. There are double damage perk combinations available with Dragonfly in the first trait perk column, which procs a 4.5m Arc explosion on a crit kill - this is treated as weapon damage so can inherit damage boosts, and also proc subclass fragments. For Arc builds, in the second column Gear Shift stacks up to ×5 on reloads after kills or becoming Amplified for a refreshable 15s, granting up to a max ×1.35 damage boost, or for Arc target and AoE damage there's Rolling Storm to generate ×1 stack of Arc Bolt Charge (×2 when Amplified) on a kill, to trigger a lightning bolt at ×10 stacks, or Voltshot applies Arc Jolt to the next target you hit within 8s, after a reload within 5.3s of a kill, for additional damage on further hits plus chain lightning damage on nearby enemies. Aegis ranks the Crossing Over origin trait as F-Tier for PvE - it provides a little extra range and handling in the top half of the mag, and a small damage boost in the bottom starting at ×1.015 at 50% and ×1.03 with your penultimate and last shot. If you're interested, Prosecutor operates alongside other Prophecy Dungeon weapons like Adjudicator, Judgement, and Relentless to evoke a clinical, cosmic courtroom where The Nine evaluate humanity's worthiness. Recommended MW: Handling or Stability, with your preferred choice of mod to boost weapon stats, ammo generation, or elemental pickups for builds. |tags:PvE PvE-Minor PvE-SingleAdd PvE-God Arc-Build M+KB Controller

// Chrysura Melo - PvE Utility god 1
// (Full Bore, Hammer-Forged Rifling, Extended Barrel, Smallbore, Corkscrew Rifling), (Tactical Mag, Appended Mag, Alloy Mag, Flared Magwell, Light Mag), (Jolting Feedback), (Circle of Life, Frenzy, Rolling Storm, Voltshot, Attrition Orbs)
//notes:Constructed by @Adamsdown_Boy (PvE PvE-Minor PvE-Utility PvE-GroupAdd PvE-EndGame PvE-God Arc-Build M+KB Controller): First-choice PvE roll for clearing individual Minor adds or tougher enemies in activities rated Normal, Hard or Very Hard difficulty, particularly for Arc builds. Chrysura Melo is a support-frame auto rifle, which are rated B-Tier for endgame PvE by @TheAegisRelic Endgame Analysis Spreadsheet​, who says "damage profile is serviceable, also has two niches in boosting damage and survivability". The frame intrinsic offers built in Anti-Overload, and it shoots tracking projectiles at enemies - any ability or weapon damage generates weapon energy that can be used when hipfiring at allies to heal them, with rapid healing also applying Amplified as per the Destiny Data Compendium. On Support Frames, the Range stat determines how far your bullets will travel before vanishing, so look for that with the barrel perk. In the magazine perk slot, look for perks that improve Range, mag size or Reload Speed. For Arc builds, there's the opportunity for double damage perks with Jolting Feedback in the first trait perk column applying Arc Jolt after 14 hits (11 when amplified) to tougher enemies who can survive the weapon damage, triggering chain lightning on further hits for both target and AoE damage. In the second column, for straight damage, Circle of Life provides a ×1.25 damage boost for a refreshable 10s after rapidly healing allies, or Frenzy after being in combat for 12s - that's dealing or taking damage - boosts Handling and Reload Speed by +100 and boosts damage by ×1.15 for a refreshable 7.2s. For additional arc splash damage, Rolling Storm generates ×1 stack of Arc Bolt Charge (×2 when Amplified) on a kill, to trigger a lightning bolt at ×10 stacks for both target and AoE damage, or Voltshot applies Arc Jolt to the next target you hit within 8s, after a reload within 5.3s of a kill, for additional damage to the target on further hits plus AoE chain lightning damage on nearby enemies. Or for utility, Attrition Orbs spawns a power orb after ~26 hits within 5s of each other to proc armour mods. Aegis ranks the Ignoble Deeds origin trait as C-Tier for PvE - inflicting an elemental debuff grants 2 stacks, up to a max of 10. One a kill, a stack is consumed to grant +35 to both Handling and Reload Speed until you run out of stacks. If you're interested, the name derives from Greek roots - Chrysura meaning "golden tail", which is a genus of parasitic cuckoo wasps, while Melo stems from "melos" meaning "song" or "melody" - combined, the name translates to "Parasitic Song". Recommended MW: Handling or Stability, with your preferred choice of mod to boost weapon stats, ammo generation, or elemental pickups for builds. |tags:PvE PvE-Minor PvE-Utility PvE-GroupAdd PvE-EndGame PvE-God Arc-Build M+KB Controller

// Chrysura Melo - PvE Utility god 3
// (Full Bore, Hammer-Forged Rifling, Extended Barrel, Smallbore, Corkscrew Rifling), (Tactical Mag, Appended Mag, Alloy Mag, Flared Magwell, Light Mag), (Trickle Charge), (Circle of Life, Frenzy, Rolling Storm, Attrition Orbs)
//notes:Constructed by @Adamsdown_Boy (PvE PvE-Minor PvE-Utility PvE-GroupAdd PvE-EndGame PvE-God Arc-Build M+KB Controller): First-choice PvE roll for clearing individual Minor adds or tougher enemies in activities rated Normal, Hard or Very Hard difficulty, particularly for Arc builds. Chrysura Melo is a support-frame auto rifle, which are rated B-Tier for endgame PvE by @TheAegisRelic Endgame Analysis Spreadsheet​, who says "damage profile is serviceable, also has two niches in boosting damage and survivability". The frame intrinsic offers built in Anti-Overload, and it shoots tracking projectiles at enemies - any ability or weapon damage generates weapon energy that can be used when hipfiring at allies to heal them, with rapid healing also applying Amplified as per the Destiny Data Compendium. The recoil direction is just right of vertical and loose so you could improve Recoil Direction or look to boost Stability with the barrel perk to help hit crits, or Handling if you can land your shots. In the magazine perk slot, look for perks that improve mag size or Reload Speed. For Arc builds, in the first trait perk column Trickle Charge refills 10% of the magazine on receiving a stack of Arc Bolt Charge, and 20% when you discharge with a lightning bolt on a target. In the second column, for straight damage, Circle of Life provides a ×1.25 damage boost for a refreshable 10s after rapidly healing allies, or Frenzy after being in combat for 12s - that's dealing or taking damage - boosts Handling and Reload Speed by +100 and boosts damage by ×1.15 for a refreshable 7.2s. For arc splash damage, Rolling Storm generates ×1 stack of Arc Bolt Charge (×2 when Amplified) on a kill, to trigger a lightning bolt at ×10 stacks for both target and AoE damage, or Voltshot applies Arc Jolt to the next target you hit within 8s, after a reload within 5.3s of a kill, for additional damage to the target on further hits plus AoE chain lightning damage on nearby enemies. Or for utility, Attrition Orbs spawns a power orb after ~26 hits within 5s of each other to proc armour mods. Aegis ranks the Ignoble Deeds origin trait as C-Tier for PvE - inflicting an elemental debuff grants 2 stacks, up to a max of 10. One a kill, a stack is consumed to grant +35 to both Handling and Reload Speed until you run out of stacks. If you're interested, the name derives from Greek roots - Chrysura meaning "golden tail", which is a genus of parasitic cuckoo wasps, while Melo stems from "melos" meaning "song" or "melody" - combined, the name translates to "Parasitic Song". Recommended MW: Handling or Stability, with your preferred choice of mod to boost weapon stats, ammo generation, or elemental pickups for builds. |tags:PvE PvE-Minor PvE-Utility PvE-GroupAdd PvE-EndGame PvE-God Arc-Build M+KB Controller

// No Hesitation - PvE Minor god 1
// (Full Bore, Hammer-Forged Rifling, Extended Barrel, Smallbore, Corkscrew Rifling), (Tactical Mag, Appended Mag, Alloy Mag, Flared Magwell, Light Mag), (Physic), (Incandescent)
//notes:Constructed by @Adamsdown_Boy (PvE PvE-Minor PvE-Utility PvE-GroupAdd PvE-EndGame PvE-God Solar-Build M+KB Controller): First-choice PvE roll for clearing individual Minor adds or tougher enemies in activities rated Normal, Hard or Very Hard difficulty, particularly for Solar builds. No Hesitation is a support-frame auto rifle, which are rated B-Tier for endgame PvE by @TheAegisRelic Endgame Analysis Spreadsheet​, who says "damage profile is serviceable, also has two niches in boosting damage and survivability". The frame intrinsic offers built in Anti-Overload, and it shoots tracking projectiles at enemies - any ability or weapon damage generates weapon energy that can be used when hipfiring at allies to heal them, with rapid healing also applying Amplified as per the Destiny Data Compendium. On Support Frames, the Range stat determines how far your bullets will travel before vanishing, so look for that with the barrel perk. In the magazine perk slot, look for perks that improve Range, mag size or Reload Speed. For Solar builds and to synergise with the frame intrinsic, in the first trait perk column Physic applies Restoration ×1 for 5s (7.5s with Ember of Solace) to both the user and ally, when the support frame boost is triggered. Then, to help clear Minor add groups, Incandescent spreads +30 Solar Scorch stacks within 4m on a red bar Minor add kill (+45 stacks within 8m for orange and yellow bars), with scorch damage counting as weapon damage so can inherit damage boosts, and also proc subclass fragments. All of the scorch stacks are increased by ×1.5 with Ember of Ashes. Aegis ranks the Dealer's Choice origin trait as S-Tier for PvE - it provides an escalating bonus to super generation on a kill, depending on how many other Dealer's Choice weapons are equipped - with three, this is the fastest way bar none to generate super energy. Recommended MW: Handling or Stability, with your preferred choice of mod to boost weapon stats, ammo generation, or elemental pickups for builds. |tags:PvE PvE-Minor PvE-Utility PvE-GroupAdd PvE-EndGame PvE-God Solar-Build M+KB Controller

// No Hesitation - PvE Minor god 2
// (Full Bore, Hammer-Forged Rifling, Extended Barrel, Smallbore, Corkscrew Rifling), (Tactical Mag, Appended Mag, Alloy Mag, Flared Magwell, Light Mag), (Physic), (Chaos Reshaped, Frenzy, Elemental Honing)
//notes:Constructed by @Adamsdown_Boy (PvE PvE-Minor PvE-Utility PvE-GroupAdd PvE-EndGame PvE-God Solar-Build M+KB Controller): First-choice PvE roll for clearing individual Minor adds or tougher enemies in activities rated Normal, Hard or Very Hard difficulty, particularly for Solar builds. No Hesitation is a support-frame auto rifle, which are rated B-Tier for endgame PvE by @TheAegisRelic Endgame Analysis Spreadsheet​, who says "damage profile is serviceable, also has two niches in boosting damage and survivability". The frame intrinsic offers built in Anti-Overload, and it shoots tracking projectiles at enemies - any ability or weapon damage generates weapon energy that can be used when hipfiring at allies to heal them, with rapid healing also applying Amplified as per the Destiny Data Compendium. On Support Frames, the Range stat determines how far your bullets will travel before vanishing, so look for that with the barrel perk. In the magazine perk slot, look for perks that improve Range, mag size or Reload Speed. To synergise with the frame intrinsic, in the first trait perk column Physic applies Restoration ×1 for 5s (7.5s with Ember of Solace on a Solar subclass) to both the user and ally, when the support frame boost is triggered. In the second column for damage, Chaos Reshaped stacks up to ×2 on dealing or receiving damage within a 5s window for at least 11.5s - at ×1 it provides a ×1.2 damage boost for a refreshable 7s and then at ×2 provides ×1.35 damage for a refreshable 7s together with a healing burst of up to 35HP that also starts health regeneration - although this is bugged, so while it's active it interrupts natural recovery and prevents regenerating the final 20-25% of your health bar. There's also Frenzy which after being in combat for 12s - that's dealing or taking damage - boosts Handling and Reload Speed by +100 and boosts damage by ×1.15 for a refreshable 7.2s, until you're out of combat again. If you're running a Prismatic build, also worth considering is Elemental Honing which grants an escalating stack of damage up to max ×1.35 (elemental) for 23s for each elemental damage type inflicted, which can be refreshed with a new damage type until you've run through all 5. Aegis ranks the Dealer's Choice origin trait as S-Tier for PvE - it provides an escalating bonus to super generation on a kill, depending on how many other Dealer's Choice weapons are equipped - with three, this is the fastest way bar none to generate super energy - on a Prismatic subclass with Elemental Supercharger (on Tablet of Ruin), the super generation in add phases is bonkers. Recommended MW: Handling or Stability, with your preferred choice of mod to boost weapon stats, ammo generation, or elemental pickups for builds. |tags:PvE PvE-Minor PvE-Utility PvE-GroupAdd PvE-EndGame PvE-God Solar-Build M+KB Controller

// No Hesitation - PvE Minor god 4
// (Full Bore, Hammer-Forged Rifling, Extended Barrel, Smallbore, Corkscrew Rifling), (Tactical Mag, Appended Mag, Alloy Mag, Flared Magwell, Light Mag), (Target Lock), (Incandescent)
//notes:Constructed by @Adamsdown_Boy (PvE PvE-Minor PvE-Utility PvE-GroupAdd PvE-EndGame PvE-God Solar-Build M+KB Controller): First-choice PvE roll for clearing individual Minor adds or tougher enemies in activities rated Normal, Hard or Very Hard difficulty, particularly with Solar builds. No Hesitation is a support-frame auto rifle, which are rated B-Tier for endgame PvE by @TheAegisRelic Endgame Analysis Spreadsheet​, who says "damage profile is serviceable, also has two niches in boosting damage and survivability". The frame intrinsic offers built in Anti-Overload, and it shoots tracking projectiles at enemies - any ability or weapon damage generates weapon energy that can be used when hipfiring at allies to heal them, with rapid healing also applying Amplified as per the Destiny Data Compendium. On Support Frames, the Range stat determines how far your bullets will travel before vanishing, so look for that with the barrel perk. In the magazine perk slot, look for perks that improve Range, mag size or Reload Speed. You can roll double damage trait perks with Target Lock in the first column which stacks up to 5 times on repeated hits within 0.2s of each other, for up to ×1.4 damage at 110.33% of base magazine capacity. In the second column Incandescent spreads +30 Solar Scorch stacks within 4m on a red bar Minor add kill (+45 stacks within 8m for orange and yellow bars), with scorch damage counting as weapon damage so can inherit damage boosts, and also proc subclass fragments. All of the scorch stacks are increased by ×1.5 with Ember of Ashes. Aegis ranks the Dealer's Choice origin trait as S-Tier for PvE - it provides an escalating bonus to super generation on a kill, depending on how many other Dealer's Choice weapons are equipped - with three, this is the fastest way bar none to generate super energy. Recommended MW: Handling or Stability, with your preferred choice of mod to boost weapon stats, ammo generation, or elemental pickups for builds. |tags:PvE PvE-Minor PvE-Utility PvE-GroupAdd PvE-EndGame PvE-God Solar-Build M+KB Controller

// No Hesitation - PvE Minor god 5
// (Full Bore, Hammer-Forged Rifling, Extended Barrel, Smallbore, Corkscrew Rifling), (Tactical Mag, Appended Mag, Alloy Mag, Flared Magwell, Light Mag), (Target Lock), (Chaos Reshaped, Frenzy, Elemental Honing)
//notes:Constructed by @Adamsdown_Boy (PvE PvE-Minor PvE-SingleAdd PvE-EndGame PvE-God M+KB Controller): First-choice PvE roll for clearing individual Minor adds or tougher enemies in activities rated Normal, Hard or Very Hard difficulty. No Hesitation is a support-frame auto rifle, which are rated B-Tier for endgame PvE by @TheAegisRelic Endgame Analysis Spreadsheet​, who says "damage profile is serviceable, also has two niches in boosting damage and survivability". The frame intrinsic offers built in Anti-Overload, and it shoots tracking projectiles at enemies - any ability or weapon damage generates weapon energy that can be used when hipfiring at allies to heal them, with rapid healing also applying Amplified as per the Destiny Data Compendium. On Support Frames, the Range stat determines how far your bullets will travel before vanishing, so look for that with the barrel perk. In the magazine perk slot, look for perks that improve Range, mag size or Reload Speed. You can roll double damage trait perks with Target Lock in the first column which stacks up to 5 times on repeated hits within 0.2s of each other, for up to ×1.4 damage at 110.33% of base magazine capacity. In the second column for damage, Chaos Reshaped stacks up to ×2 on dealing or receiving damage within a 5s window for at least 11.5s - at ×1 it provides a ×1.2 damage boost for a refreshable 7s and then at ×2 provides ×1.35 damage for a refreshable 7s together with a healing burst of up to 35HP that also starts health regeneration - although this is bugged, so while it's active it interrupts natural recovery and prevents regenerating the final 20-25% of your health bar. There's also Frenzy which after being in combat for 12s - that's dealing or taking damage - boosts Handling and Reload Speed by +100 and boosts damage by ×1.15 for a refreshable 7.2s, until you're out of combat again. If you're running a Prismatic build, also worth considering is Elemental Honing which grants an escalating stack of damage up to max ×1.35 (elemental) for 23s for each elemental damage type inflicted, which can be refreshed with a new damage type until you've run through all 5. Aegis ranks the Dealer's Choice origin trait as S-Tier for PvE - it provides an escalating bonus to super generation on a kill, depending on how many other Dealer's Choice weapons are equipped - with three, this is the fastest way bar none to generate super energy - on a Prismatic subclass with Elemental Supercharger (on Tablet of Ruin), the super generation in add phases is bonkers. Recommended MW: Handling or Stability, with your preferred choice of mod to boost weapon stats, ammo generation, or elemental pickups for builds. |tags:PvE PvE-Minor PvE-SingleAdd PvE-EndGame PvE-God M+KB Controller

// DECATUR 02 - PvE Minor god 1
// (Full Bore, Hammer-Forged Rifling, Extended Barrel, Smallbore, Corkscrew Rifling), (Accurized Rounds, Tactical Mag, Appended Mag, Alloy Mag, Flared Magwell, Light Mag), (Crystalline Corpsebloom), (Rimestealer, Circle of Life, Rampage, Master of Arms, Redirection)
//notes:Constructed by @Adamsdown_Boy (PvE PvE-Minor PvE-Utility PvE-GroupAdd PvE-God Stasis-Build M+KB Controller): First-choice PvE roll for clearing groups of Minor adds in activities rated Normal difficulty, particularly for Stasis builds. DECATUR 02 is a support-frame auto rifle, which are rated B-Tier for endgame PvE by @TheAegisRelic Endgame Analysis Spreadsheet​, who says "damage profile is serviceable, also has two niches in boosting damage and survivability". The frame intrinsic offers built in Anti-Overload, and it shoots tracking projectiles at enemies - any ability or weapon damage generates weapon energy that can be used when hipfiring at allies to heal them, with rapid healing also applying stacks of Frost Armor as per the Destiny Data Compendium. On Support Frames, the Range stat determines how far your bullets will travel before vanishing, so look for that with the barrel perk. In the magazine perk slot, look for perks that improve Range, mag size or Reload Speed. For Stasis synergy, in the first trait perk column Crystalline Corpsebloom procs on a kill to provide a 4s buff - kills with the buff active generate a Stasis seeker which travels 3m before spawning a large Stasis crystal - these are weapon-generated entities so can inherit damage buffs, and proc weapon traits and subclass fragments when shattered for AoE damage. In the second column, for more Stasis synergy Rimestealer generates ×2 stacks of Stasis Frost Armor on shattering a Stasis crystal or killing a frozen enemy. To work with the frame intrinsic, Circle of Life provides an additional ×1.25 damage boost for a refreshable 10s after rapidly healing allies. Otherwise, for straight damage there's Rampage which stacks up to ×3 on kills for max ×1.331 damage for a refreshable 5s, with the stacks decaying one at a time, Master of Arms to provide ×1.15 damage for 8s after a kill with any weapon, with a second stack of ×1.25 for 5s on any kills with the first stack active, or Redirection stores damage by hitting red bar adds, for 2 stacks per hit up to 30 stacks, for use against orange and yellow bar enemies for ×1.5 damage at two stacks consumed per shot. Aegis ranks the Carrion Munitions origin trait as S-Tier for PvE - it has an internal counter based on weapon damage, and when this hits 100% an insectoid robot spawns which tracks enemies within 25m and explodes for 5m AoE damage. If you're interested, the name (like the rest of the Distortion weapons set) is derived from names tied to prominent shipping, transport, and logistics zones across the United States. Etymologically, it refers to Decatur, Illinois (or Decatur, Alabama), a major inland transit hub. Recommended MW: Handling or Stability, with your preferred choice of mod to boost weapon stats, ammo generation, or elemental pickups for builds. |tags:PvE PvE-Minor PvE-Utility PvE-GroupAdd PvE-God Stasis-Build M+KB Controller

// DECATUR 02 - PvE Minor god 2
// (Full Bore, Hammer-Forged Rifling, Extended Barrel, Smallbore, Corkscrew Rifling), (Accurized Rounds, Tactical Mag, Appended Mag, Alloy Mag, Flared Magwell, Light Mag), (Physic), (Rimestealer, Rampage, Master of Arms, Redirection)
//notes:Constructed by @Adamsdown_Boy (PvE PvE-Minor PvE-Utility PvE-SingleAdd PvE-God Stasis-Build M+KB Controller): First-choice PvE roll for clearing individual Minor adds or tougher enemies in activities rated Normal difficulty, particularly for Stasis builds. DECATUR 02 is a support-frame auto rifle, which are rated B-Tier for endgame PvE by @TheAegisRelic Endgame Analysis Spreadsheet​, who says "damage profile is serviceable, also has two niches in boosting damage and survivability". The frame intrinsic offers built in Anti-Overload, and it shoots tracking projectiles at enemies - any ability or weapon damage generates weapon energy that can be used when hipfiring at allies to heal them, with rapid healing also applying stacks of Frost Armor as per the Destiny Data Compendium. On Support Frames, the Range stat determines how far your bullets will travel before vanishing, so look for that with the barrel perk. In the magazine perk slot, look for perks that improve Range, mag size or Reload Speed. For Stasis synergy, the first trait perk column Physic applies ×2 stacks of Frost Armor to both the user and ally, when the support frame boost is triggered. In the second column, if you're on a Stasis subclass that can generate stasis crystals Rimestealer also generates ×2 stacks of Stasis Frost Armor on shattering a Stasis crystal or killing a frozen enemy. Otherwise, for straight damage there's Rampage which stacks up to ×3 on kills for max ×1.331 damage for a refreshable 5s, with the stacks decaying one at a time, Master of Arms to provide ×1.15 damage for 8s after a kill with any weapon, with a second stack of ×1.25 for 5s on any kills with the first stack active, or Redirection stores damage by hitting red bar adds, for 2 stacks per hit up to 30 stacks, for use against orange and yellow bar enemies for ×1.5 damage at two stacks consumed per shot. Aegis ranks the Carrion Munitions origin trait as S-Tier for PvE - it has an internal counter based on weapon damage, and when this hits 100% an insectoid robot spawns which tracks enemies within 25m and explodes for 5m AoE damage. If you're interested, the name (like the rest of the Distortion weapons set) is derived from names tied to prominent shipping, transport, and logistics zones across the United States. Etymologically, it refers to Decatur, Illinois (or Decatur, Alabama), a major inland transit hub. Recommended MW: Handling or Stability, with your preferred choice of mod to boost weapon stats, ammo generation, or elemental pickups for builds. |tags:PvE PvE-Minor PvE-Utility PvE-SingleAdd PvE-God Stasis-Build M+KB Controller

// DECATUR 02 - PvE Minor god 3
// (Full Bore, Hammer-Forged Rifling, Extended Barrel, Smallbore, Corkscrew Rifling), (Accurized Rounds, Tactical Mag, Appended Mag, Alloy Mag, Flared Magwell, Light Mag), (Attrition Orbs), (Rimestealer, Rampage, Master of Arms, Redirection)
//notes:Constructed by @Adamsdown_Boy (PvE PvE-Minor PvE-Utility PvE-SingleAdd PvE-God M+KB Controller): First-choice PvE roll for clearing individual Minor adds or tougher enemies in activities rated Normal difficulty. DECATUR 02 is a support-frame auto rifle, which are rated B-Tier for endgame PvE by @TheAegisRelic Endgame Analysis Spreadsheet​, who says "damage profile is serviceable, also has two niches in boosting damage and survivability". The frame intrinsic offers built in Anti-Overload, and it shoots tracking projectiles at enemies - any ability or weapon damage generates weapon energy that can be used when hipfiring at allies to heal them, with rapid healing also applying stacks of Frost Armor as per the Destiny Data Compendium. On Support Frames, the Range stat determines how far your bullets will travel before vanishing, so look for that with the barrel perk. In the magazine perk slot, look for perks that improve Range, mag size or Reload Speed. In the first trait perk column Attrition Orbs spawns a power orb after ~23 hits within 5s of each other to proc armour mods. In the second column, if you're on a Stasis subclass that can generate stasis crystals Rimestealer generates ×2 stacks of Stasis Frost Armor on shattering a Stasis crystal or killing a frozen enemy. Otherwise, for straight damage there's Rampage which stacks up to ×3 on kills for max ×1.331 damage for a refreshable 5s, with the stacks decaying one at a time, Master of Arms to provide ×1.15 damage for 8s after a kill with any weapon, with a second stack of ×1.25 for 5s on any kills with the first stack active, or Redirection stores damage by hitting red bar adds, for 2 stacks per hit up to 30 stacks, for use against orange and yellow bar enemies for ×1.5 damage at two stacks consumed per shot. Aegis ranks the Carrion Munitions origin trait as S-Tier for PvE - it has an internal counter based on weapon damage, and when this hits 100% an insectoid robot spawns which tracks enemies within 25m and explodes for 5m AoE damage. If you're interested, the name (like the rest of the Distortion weapons set) is derived from names tied to prominent shipping, transport, and logistics zones across the United States. Etymologically, it refers to Decatur, Illinois (or Decatur, Alabama), a major inland transit hub. // DECATUR 02 - PvE Minor god 4
// (Full Bore, Hammer-Forged Rifling, Extended Barrel, Smallbore, Corkscrew Rifling), (Accurized Rounds, Tactical Mag, Appended Mag, Alloy Mag, Flared Magwell, Light Mag), (Physic, Attrition Orbs), (Circle of Life)
//notes:Constructed by @Adamsdown_Boy (PvE PvE-Minor PvE-Utility PvE-SingleAdd PvE-EndGame PvE-God Stasis-Build M+KB Controller): First-choice PvE roll for clearing individual Minor adds or tougher enemies in activities rated Normal, Hard or Very Hard difficulty, particularly for Stasis builds. DECATUR 02 is a support-frame auto rifle, which are rated B-Tier for endgame PvE by @TheAegisRelic Endgame Analysis Spreadsheet​, who says "damage profile is serviceable, also has two niches in boosting damage and survivability". The frame intrinsic offers built in Anti-Overload, and it shoots tracking projectiles at enemies - any ability or weapon damage generates weapon energy that can be used when hipfiring at allies to heal them, with rapid healing also applying stacks of Frost Armor as per the Destiny Data Compendium. On Support Frames, the Range stat determines how far your bullets will travel before vanishing, so look for that with the barrel perk. In the magazine perk slot, look for perks that improve Range, mag size or Reload Speed. For Stasis synergy, the first trait perk column Physic applies ×2 stacks of Frost Armor to both the user and ally, when the support frame boost is triggered, or Attrition Orbs spawns a power orb after ~23 hits within 5s of each other to proc armour mods. In the second column, to work with the frame intrinsic, Circle of Life provides an additional ×1.25 damage boost for a refreshable 10s after rapidly healing allies. Aegis ranks the Carrion Munitions origin trait as S-Tier for PvE - it has an internal counter based on weapon damage, and when this hits 100% an insectoid robot spawns which tracks enemies within 25m and explodes for 5m AoE damage. If you're interested, the name (like the rest of the Distortion weapons set) is derived from names tied to prominent shipping, transport, and logistics zones across the United States. Etymologically, it refers to Decatur, Illinois (or Decatur, Alabama), a major inland transit hub. // Zealous Ideal - PvE Minor god 1
// (Fluted Barrel, Arrowhead Brake, Corkscrew Rifling, Polygonal Rifling, Smallbore, Hammer-Forged Rifling), (Enhanced Heatsink, Ionized Heatsink, Accelerated Heatsink, Light Heatsink, Tactical Heatsink), (Attrittion Orbs), (Burning Ambition)
//notes:Constructed by @Adamsdown_Boy (PvE PvE-Minor PvE-SingleAdd PvE-EndGame PvE-God Solar-Build M+KB Controller): First-choice PvE roll for clearing individual Minor adds or tougher enemies in activities rated Normal, Hard or Very Hard difficulty, particularly with Solar builds. Zealous Ideal is a balanced heat auto rifle, which are rated C-Tier for endgame PvE by @TheAegisRelic Endgame Analysis Spreadsheet​, who says "strict downgrade from adaptive". The frame intrinsic offers built in Anti-Overload, and is like an extra perk set, first providing reduced heat generation, significantly increasing the number of shots before overheating, and providing a pseudo-Reconstruction, automatically "refilling" as the weapon loses heat when not being used. Additionally, there's an intrinsic ×1.15 damage boost against orange and yellow bars and vehicles, plus a ×2 vent rate if you manually reload when the heat bar is at >87.5% of maximum heat to proc Perfect Vent, as per the Destiny Data Compendium. With the Recoil Direction already at 95, you can take your pick with the barrel perk to boost Handling, Stability or Range. In the battery perk slot, look for something that reduces heat generation, or improves cooling efficiency or vent speed. In the first trait perk slot, Attrition Orbs spawns a power orb after ~21 hits within 5s of each other to proc armour mods. You'll need a Solar subclass with a scorch ability to make the most of Burning Ambition in the second column to build Solar ignitions on tougher targets - if you can't apply scorch first, it'll take ~21 hits within 2s of each other to apply +10 scorch stacks with +10 added on each additional hit to build towards an ignition. All of the scorch stacks are increased by ×1.5 with Ember of Ashes. Aegis ranks the Imperial Allegiance origin trait as A-Tier for PvE if you're in a fireteam - it stacks up to ×3 per ally within 15m, boosting cooling by a max ×1.105 and increasing damage when above 50% heat by max ×1.105. If you're interested, this is modelled on the E-11 medium blaster rifle, the standard-issue weapon for the Galactic Empire's stormtroopers, while the name refers to the rigid, uncompromising pursuit of a perfect standard or cause. Recommended MW: Handling or Stability, with your preferred choice of mod to boost weapon stats, ammo generation, or elemental pickups for builds. |tags:PvE PvE-Minor PvE-SingleAdd PvE-EndGame PvE-God Solar-Build M+KB Controller

// Zealous Ideal - PvE Minor god 2
// (Fluted Barrel, Arrowhead Brake, Corkscrew Rifling, Polygonal Rifling, Smallbore, Hammer-Forged Rifling), (Enhanced Heatsink, Ionized Heatsink, Accelerated Heatsink, Light Heatsink, Tactical Heatsink), (Attrittion Orbs, Heal Clip), (One For All, Onslaught)
//notes:Constructed by @Adamsdown_Boy (PvE PvE-Minor PvE-SingleAdd PvE-EndGame PvE-God M+KB Controller): First-choice PvE roll for clearing individual Minor adds or tougher enemies in activities rated Normal, Hard or Very Hard difficulty. Zealous Ideal is a balanced heat auto rifle, which are rated C-Tier for endgame PvE by @TheAegisRelic Endgame Analysis Spreadsheet​, who says "strict downgrade from adaptive". The frame intrinsic offers built in Anti-Overload, and is like an extra perk set, first providing reduced heat generation, significantly increasing the number of shots before overheating, and providing a pseudo-Reconstruction, automatically "refilling" as the weapon loses heat when not being used. Additionally, there's an intrinsic ×1.15 damage boost against orange and yellow bars and vehicles, plus a ×2 vent rate if you manually reload when the heat bar is at >87.5% of maximum heat to proc Perfect Vent, as per the Destiny Data Compendium. With the Recoil Direction already at 95, you can take your pick with the barrel perk to boost Handling, Stability or Range. In the battery perk slot, look for something that reduces heat generation, or improves cooling efficiency or vent speed. In the first trait perk slot, Attrition Orbs spawns a power orb after ~21 hits within 5s of each other to proc armour mods or Heal Clip provides ×2 Solar Cure (140 HP), and ×1 Cure on allies within 15m, when you finish a reload within ~5.5s after a kill. In the second column, for damage, One For All boosts damage by ×1.35 for a non-refreshable 11s after hitting three separate targets within 3s of each, or Onslaught, while not boosting damage per shot does increase raw DPS as you ramp up to the max ×3 stacks, for a refreshable 5s per kill, to increase RPM from 450 to around max 720. Aegis ranks the Imperial Allegiance origin trait as A-Tier for PvE if you're in a fireteam - it stacks up to ×3 per ally within 15m, boosting cooling by a max ×1.105 and increasing damage when above 50% heat by max ×1.105. If you're interested, this is modelled on the E-11 medium blaster rifle, the standard-issue weapon for the Galactic Empire's stormtroopers, while the name refers to the rigid, uncompromising pursuit of a perfect standard or cause. // Zealous Ideal - PvE Minor god 3
// (Fluted Barrel, Arrowhead Brake, Corkscrew Rifling, Polygonal Rifling, Smallbore, Hammer-Forged Rifling), (Enhanced Heatsink, Ionized Heatsink, Accelerated Heatsink, Light Heatsink, Tactical Heatsink), (Attrittion Orbs, Heal Clip), (Incandescent)
//notes:Constructed by @Adamsdown_Boy (PvE PvE-Minor PvE-GroupAdd PvE-EndGame PvE-God Solar-Build M+KB Controller): First-choice PvE roll for clearing individual Minor adds or tougher enemies in activities rated Normal, Hard or Very Hard difficulty, particularly with Solar builds. Zealous Ideal is a balanced heat auto rifle, which are rated C-Tier for endgame PvE by @TheAegisRelic Endgame Analysis Spreadsheet​, who says "strict downgrade from adaptive". The frame intrinsic offers built in Anti-Overload, and is like an extra perk set, first providing reduced heat generation, significantly increasing the number of shots before overheating, and providing a pseudo-Reconstruction, automatically "refilling" as the weapon loses heat when not being used. Additionally, there's an intrinsic ×1.15 damage boost against orange and yellow bars and vehicles, plus a ×2 vent rate if you manually reload when the heat bar is at >87.5% of maximum heat to proc Perfect Vent, as per the Destiny Data Compendium. With the Recoil Direction already at 95, you can take your pick with the barrel perk to boost Handling, Stability or Range. In the battery perk slot, look for something that reduces heat generation, or improves cooling efficiency or vent speed. In the first trait perk slot, Attrition Orbs spawns a power orb after ~21 hits within 5s of each other to proc armour mods or Heal Clip provides ×2 Solar Cure (140 HP), and ×1 Cure on allies within 15m, when you finish a reload within ~5.5s after a kill. In the second column, for Solar builds, Incandescent spreads +30 Solar Scorch stacks within 4m on a red bar Minor add kill (+45 stacks within 8m for orange and yellow bars), with scorch damage counting as weapon damage so can inherit damage boosts, and also proc subclass fragments and weapon traits like Attrition Orbs' orb generation. All of the scorch stacks are increased by ×1.5 with Ember of Ashes. Aegis ranks the Imperial Allegiance origin trait as A-Tier for PvE if you're in a fireteam - it stacks up to ×3 per ally within 15m, boosting cooling by a max ×1.105 and increasing damage when above 50% heat by max ×1.105. If you're interested, this is modelled on the E-11 medium blaster rifle, the standard-issue weapon for the Galactic Empire's stormtroopers, while the name refers to the rigid, uncompromising pursuit of a perfect standard or cause. Recommended MW: Handling or Stability, with your preferred choice of mod to boost weapon stats, ammo generation, or elemental pickups for builds. |tags:PvE PvE-Minor PvE-SingleAdd PvE-EndGame PvE-God Solar-Build M+KB Controller
