// Lethal Abundance - PvE Minor god 1
// (Arrowhead Brake, Chambered Compensator, Extended Barrel, Fluted Barrel, Corkscrew Rifling, Polygonal Rifling, Smallbore, Hammer-Forged Rifling), (Tactical Mag, Appended Mag, Alloy Mag, Flared Magwell, Light Mag), (Slice, Tear), (Hatchling, One For All)
//notes:Constructed by @Adamsdown_Boy (PvE PvE-Minor PvE-GroupAdd PvE-EndGame PvE-God Strand-Build M+KB Controller): First-choice PvE roll for clearing groups of Minor adds in activities rated Normal, Hard or Very Hard difficulty, particularly with Strand builds. Lethal Abundance is a high-impact auto rifle, which are rated B-Tier for endgame PvE by @TheAegisRelic Endgame Analysis Spreadsheet​, who says "range outlier with good stagger access, 2nd best damage profile despite low fire rate". The frame intrinsic offers built in Anti-Unstoppable, and ×0.8 accuracy cone size and ×0.83 accuracy cone growth when moving 2.8m/s or less (crouch walking speed) as per the Destiny Data Compendium. The recoil direction is slightly left of vertical and tight so you could take the Recoil Direction to 100 with the barrel perk or look to boost Stability to help hit crits, or Handling if you can land your shots. In the magazine perk slot, look for perks that improve mag size or Reload Speed. For Strand builds, in the first trait perk column Slice procs for 9s after using a class ability, to Sever up to 5 enemies for a refreshable 10s, or Tear spreads ~4m AoE Strand Sever on a crit kill, to reduce damage output to ×0.6 from enemies affected. You can double down into Strand in the second column with Hatchling spawns a Strand Threadling on a crit kill or three crit hits within 3s of each other or just go for a straight damage perk with One For All which boosts damage by ×1.35 for a non-refreshable 11s after hitting three separate targets within 3s of each. Aegis ranks the Skulking Wolf origin trait as A-Tier for PvE which, after you get a kill at ≤90 HP, enhances radar and makes adds less accurate when firing at you for 10s - similar to when you're Amplified. If you're interested, this was originally introduced during Season of the Wish, with the name implying the concept of too many Ahamkara wishes becoming a deadly curse. Recommended MW: Handling or Stability, with your preferred choice of mod to boost weapon stats, ammo generation, or elemental pickups for builds. |tags:PvE PvE-Minor PvE-GroupAdd PvE-EndGame PvE-God Strand-Build M+KB Controller

// Reckless Oracle - PvE Minor god 1
// (Arrowhead Brake, Chambered Compensator, Extended Barrel, Fluted Barrel, Corkscrew Rifling, Polygonal Rifling, Smallbore, Hammer-Forged Rifling), (High-Caliber Rounds, Armor-Piercing Rounds, Ricochet Rounds, Appended Mag, Alloy Mag, Flared Magwell, Light Mag), (Dimensional Shift, Light Touch), (Demoralize)
//notes:Constructed by @Adamsdown_Boy (PvE PvE-Minor PvE-GroupAdd PvE-God Void-Build M+KB Controller): First-choice PvE roll for clearing groups of Minor adds or tougher enemies in activities rated Normal difficulty, particularly with Void builds. Reckless Oracle is a rapid-fire auto rifle, which are rated C-Tier for endgame PvE by @TheAegisRelic Endgame Analysis Spreadsheet​, who says "solid damage profile but a strict step down compared to adaptive in same range tier". The frame intrinsic offers built in Anti-Overload, better total ammo reserves and a ×0.8 reload animation scalar when the magazine is empty as per the Destiny Data Compendium. The recoil direction is right of vertical and loose so you could improve Recoil Direction or look to boost Stability with the barrel perk to help hit crits, or Handling if you can land your shots. In the magazine perk slot, the combat effect perks work well, or look for perks that improve mag size or Reload Speed. For Void builds, in the first trait perk column Dimensional Shift grants Dimensional Breach on picking up a Void Breach which, while active provides a refreshable 8s overshield on kills or Light Touch boosts Handling and Reload Speed, and provides an ADS scalar while you're Amplified or Radiant, or Devour is active. In the second column, Demoralize spreads a ~4m AoE cloud of Void Weaken for a ×1.15 boost to damage for your fireteam for 5s on a crit kill, which you can use with Echoes of Harvest and Starvation to continuously proc Devour. Aegis ranks the Photoinhibition origin trait as B-Tier for PvE - it boosts shield, overshield and barrier damage, disorienting for 5s on a shield break, and AoE disorienting enemies in a 5m radius on a matching Void shield break. If you're interested, the name draws a parallel between the Vex's fatalistic timeline-weaving mechanics and the tragic hubris of the Kentarch 3 - a fireteam of Guardians who accepted Dark powers within the Black Garden, representing the dangerous folly of pursuing forbidden, absolute knowledge while actively accelerating toward a grim, predetermined fate. Recommended MW: Handling or Stability, with your preferred choice of mod to boost weapon stats, ammo generation, or elemental pickups for builds. |tags:PvE PvE-Minor PvE-GroupAdd PvE-God Void-Build M+KB Controller

// Arctic Haze - PvE Minor god 1
// (Arrowhead Brake, Chambered Compensator, Extended Barrel, Fluted Barrel, Corkscrew Rifling, Polygonal Rifling, Smallbore, Hammer-Forged Rifling), (Tactical Mag, Appended Mag, Alloy Mag, Flared Magwell), (Incandescent), (Burning Ambition)
//notes:Constructed by @Adamsdown_Boy (PvE PvE-Minor PvE-GroupAdd PvE-EndGame PvE-God Solar-Build M+KB Controller): First-choice PvE roll for clearing groups of Minor adds in activities rated Normal, Hard or Very Hard difficulty, particularly with Solar builds. Arctic Haze is a rapid-fire auto rifle, which are rated C-Tier for endgame PvE by @TheAegisRelic Endgame Analysis Spreadsheet​, who says "solid damage profile but a strict step down compared to adaptive in same range tier". The frame intrinsic offers built in Anti-Overload, better total ammo reserves and a ×0.8 reload animation scalar when the magazine is empty as per the Destiny Data Compendium. The recoil direction is right of vertical and very loose so you could improve Recoil Direction or look to boost Stability with the barrel perk to help hit crits, or Handling if you can land your shots. In the magazine perk slot, look for perks that improve mag size or Reload Speed. For a roll to clear both group and tougher individual adds, and which also synergises with Solar builds, in the first trait perk column Incandescent spreads +30 Solar Scorch stacks within 4m on a red bar Minor add kill (+45 stacks within 8m for orange and yellow bars), with scorch damage counting as weapon damage so can inherit damage boosts, and also proc subclass fragments. In the second column, you can use a scorch ability to make the most of Burning Ambition to build Solar ignitions on tougher targets. If you can't apply scorch first, it'll take ~28 hits within 2s of each other to apply +10 scorch stacks, with +10 added on each additional hit afterwards to build towards an ignition. All of the scorch stacks for both perks are increased by ×1.5 with Ember of Ashes. Aegis ranks the Winterized Gear origin trait as F-Tier for PvE - it provides ×3 stacks after 12s out of combat - each stack decays after 5s in combat providing a gradually reducing boost to Stability, Handling and Reload Speed. If you're interested, the name functions as a literal description of its frozen, storm-swept source world of Europa. Recommended MW: Handling or Stability, with your preferred choice of mod to boost weapon stats, ammo generation, or elemental pickups for builds. |tags:PvE PvE-Minor PvE-GroupAdd PvE-EndGame PvE-God Solar-Build M+KB Controller

// Pluperfect - PvE Utility god 1
// (Arrowhead Brake, Chambered Compensator, Extended Barrel, Fluted Barrel, Corkscrew Rifling, Polygonal Rifling, Smallbore, Hammer-Forged Rifling), (High-Caliber Rounds, Armor-Piercing Rounds, Ricochet Rounds, Appended Mag, Alloy Mag, Flared Magwell, Light Mag), (Stopping Power), (Kinetic Tremors)
//notes:Constructed by @Adamsdown_Boy (PvE PvE-Utility PvE-Minor PvE-Champion PvE-GroupAdd PvE-EndGame PvE-God M+KB Controller): First-choice PvE roll for both dealing with Unstoppable Champions and clearing groups of Minor adds in activities rated Normal, Hard or Very Hard difficulty. Pluperfect is a high-impact auto rifle, which are rated B-Tier for endgame PvE by @TheAegisRelic Endgame Analysis Spreadsheet​, who says "range outlier with good stagger access, 2nd best damage profile despite low fire rate". The frame intrinsic offers built in Anti-Unstoppable, and ×0.8 accuracy cone size and ×0.83 accuracy cone growth when moving 2.8m/s or less (crouch walking speed) as per the Destiny Data Compendium. The recoil direction is left of vertical and tight so you could take the Recoil Direction to 100 with the barrel perk or look to boost Stability to help hit crits, or Handling if you can land your shots. In the magazine perk slot, the combat effect perks - particularly High-Caliber Rounds - work well for this roll, or perks that improve mag size or Reload Speed are the best alternatives. This roll maximises stagger, as well as stunning Unstoppable Champions. For this, in the first trait perk column, Stopping Power provides increased stagger, and increased damage on low health enemies - ×1.07 when health is below 34%, ×1.1 when <23% and ×1.15 when <18%. In the second column, Kinetic Tremors emits three 6m AoE Kinetic shockwaves after 11 hits within 3s of each other, which are treated as weapon damage so inherit damage boosts. Aegis ranks the Fail Deadly origin trait as A-Tier for PvE, granting a stack per damage tick up to the base magazine size - at max stacks a reload provides ×2 magazine size, which stacks with other mag size buffs like Overflow, as well as boosting Range by +15 and Aim Assist by +5. If you're interested, the name originates from the Latin phrase "plus quam perfectum", which translates literally to "more than perfect". Pluperfect is also a verb tense (also known as the past perfect), describing an action that was completed before another event in the past, such as "By the time we landed for the Taniks checkpoint, Adams had already equipped Divinity". Recommended MW: Handling or Stability, with your preferred choice of mod to boost weapon stats, ammo generation, or elemental pickups for builds. |tags:PvE PvE-Utility PvE-Minor PvE-Champion PvE-GroupAdd PvE-EndGame PvE-God M+KB Controller

// VS Pyroelectric Propellant - PvE Minor god 1
// (Arrowhead Brake, Chambered Compensator, Extended Barrel, Fluted Barrel, Corkscrew Rifling, Polygonal Rifling, Smallbore, Hammer-Forged Rifling), (High-Caliber Rounds, Armor-Piercing Rounds, Ricochet Rounds, Appended Mag, Alloy Mag, Flared Magwell, Light Mag), (Strategist), (Jolting Feedback, Gear Shift)
//notes:Constructed by @Adamsdown_Boy (PvE PvE-Minor PvE-SingleAdd PvE-EndGame PvE-God Arc-Build M+KB Controller): First-choice PvE roll for clearing individual Minor adds or tougher enemies in activities rated Normal, Hard or Very Hard difficulty, particularly for Arc builds. VS Pyroelectric Propellant is an adaptive auto rifle, which are rated B-Tier for endgame PvE by @TheAegisRelic Endgame Analysis Spreadsheet​, who says "probably best overall auto archetype accounting for barrier intrinsic and damage profile". The frame intrinsic offers built in Anti-Barrier, but offers no bonuses beyond being "well-rounded, reliable and sturdy" as per the Destiny Data Compendium. The recoil direction is vertical and loose so you could improve Recoil Direction or look to boost Stability with the barrel perk to help hit crits, or Handling if you can land your shots. In the magazine perk slot, the combat effect perks work well, or look for perks that improve mag size or Reload Speed. There's an obvious synergy in the first trait perk column for Strategist, which generates chunk class ability energy on kills (and boosts stability for a few seconds on class ability use), for Arc Titans running Storm's Keep, but Ascension Hunters and Warlocks using rifts aggressively with Arc Soul and Ionic Sentry might also find it useful. To pair with that in the second column, Jolting Feedback applies Arc Jolt after 14 hits (11 when amplified) to tougher enemies who can survive the weapon damage, triggering chain lightning on further hits for both target and AoE damage, or Gear Shift stacks up to ×5 on reloads after kills or becoming Amplified for a refreshable 15s, granting up to a max ×1.35 damage boost. If you're interested, "VS" is the designation for Vesper Station, and "pyroelectric" describes the property of materials which generate a temporary electrical voltage when they're heated or cooled. Recommended MW: Handling or Stability, with your preferred choice of mod to boost weapon stats, ammo generation, or elemental pickups for builds. |tags:PvE PvE-Minor PvE-SingleAdd PvE-EndGame PvE-God Arc-Build M+KB Controller

// VS Pyroelectric Propellant - PvE Minor god 2
// (Arrowhead Brake, Chambered Compensator, Extended Barrel, Fluted Barrel, Corkscrew Rifling, Polygonal Rifling, Smallbore, Hammer-Forged Rifling), (High-Caliber Rounds, Armor-Piercing Rounds, Ricochet Rounds, Appended Mag, Alloy Mag, Flared Magwell, Light Mag), (Attrition Orbs), (Jolting Feedback, Gear Shift)
//notes:Constructed by @Adamsdown_Boy (PvE PvE-Minor PvE-SingleAdd PvE-EndGame PvE-God Arc-Build M+KB Controller): First-choice PvE roll for clearing individual Minor adds or tougher enemies in activities rated Normal, Hard or Very Hard difficulty, particularly for Arc builds. VS Pyroelectric Propellant is an adaptive auto rifle, which are rated B-Tier for endgame PvE by @TheAegisRelic Endgame Analysis Spreadsheet​, who says "probably best overall auto archetype accounting for barrier intrinsic and damage profile". The frame intrinsic offers built in Anti-Barrier, but offers no bonuses beyond being "well-rounded, reliable and sturdy" as per the Destiny Data Compendium. The recoil direction is vertical and loose so you could improve Recoil Direction or look to boost Stability with the barrel perk to help hit crits, or Handling if you can land your shots. In the magazine perk slot, the combat effect perks work well, or look for perks that improve mag size or Reload Speed. In the first trait perk column, Attrition Orbs spawns a power orb after ~26 hits within 5s of each other to proc armour mods. To pair with that in the second column for Arc builds, Jolting Feedback applies Arc Jolt after 14 hits (11 when amplified) to tougher enemies who can survive the weapon damage, triggering chain lightning on further hits for both target and AoE damage, or Gear Shift stacks up to ×5 on reloads after kills or becoming Amplified for a refreshable 15s, granting up to a max ×1.35 damage boost. If you're interested, "VS" is the designation for Vesper Station, and "pyroelectric" describes the property of materials which generate a temporary electrical voltage when they're heated or cooled. Recommended MW: Handling or Stability, with your preferred choice of mod to boost weapon stats, ammo generation, or elemental pickups for builds. |tags:PvE PvE-Minor PvE-SingleAdd PvE-EndGame PvE-God Arc-Build M+KB Controller

// VS Pyroelectric Propellant - PvE Minor god 3
// (Arrowhead Brake, Chambered Compensator, Extended Barrel, Fluted Barrel, Corkscrew Rifling, Polygonal Rifling, Smallbore, Hammer-Forged Rifling), (High-Caliber Rounds, Armor-Piercing Rounds, Ricochet Rounds, Appended Mag, Alloy Mag, Flared Magwell, Light Mag), (Rewind Rounds), (Jolting Feedback, Gear Shift)
//notes:Constructed by @Adamsdown_Boy (PvE PvE-Minor PvE-SingleAdd PvE-EndGame PvE-God Arc-Build M+KB Controller): First-choice PvE roll for clearing individual Minor adds or tougher enemies in activities rated Normal, Hard or Very Hard difficulty, particularly for Arc builds. VS Pyroelectric Propellant is an adaptive auto rifle, which are rated B-Tier for endgame PvE by @TheAegisRelic Endgame Analysis Spreadsheet​, who says "probably best overall auto archetype accounting for barrier intrinsic and damage profile". The frame intrinsic offers built in Anti-Barrier, but offers no bonuses beyond being "well-rounded, reliable and sturdy" as per the Destiny Data Compendium. The recoil direction is vertical and loose so you could improve Recoil Direction or look to boost Stability with the barrel perk to help hit crits, or Handling if you can land your shots. In the magazine perk slot, the combat effect perks work well, or look for perks that improve mag size or Reload Speed. In the first trait perk column, Rewind Rounds refills 70% of hits landed from reserves when the magazine empties. To pair with that in the second column for Arc builds, Jolting Feedback applies Arc Jolt after 14 hits (11 when amplified) to tougher enemies who can survive the weapon damage, triggering chain lightning on further hits for both target and AoE damage, or Gear Shift stacks up to ×5 on reloads after kills or becoming Amplified for a refreshable 15s, granting up to a max ×1.35 damage boost. If you're interested, "VS" is the designation for Vesper Station, and "pyroelectric" describes the property of materials which generate a temporary electrical voltage when they're heated or cooled. Recommended MW: Handling or Stability, with your preferred choice of mod to boost weapon stats, ammo generation, or elemental pickups for builds. |tags:PvE PvE-Minor PvE-SingleAdd PvE-EndGame PvE-God Arc-Build M+KB Controller

// VS Pyroelectric Propellant - PvE Minor god 4
// (Arrowhead Brake, Chambered Compensator, Extended Barrel, Fluted Barrel, Corkscrew Rifling, Polygonal Rifling, Smallbore, Hammer-Forged Rifling), (High-Caliber Rounds, Armor-Piercing Rounds, Ricochet Rounds, Appended Mag, Alloy Mag, Flared Magwell, Light Mag), (Rewind Rounds), (Onslaught, Target Lock)
//notes:Constructed by @Adamsdown_Boy (PvE PvE-Minor PvE-SingleAdd PvE-EndGame PvE-God M+KB Controller): First-choice PvE roll for clearing individual Minor adds or tougher enemies in activities rated Normal, Hard or Very Hard difficulty. VS Pyroelectric Propellant is an adaptive auto rifle, which are rated B-Tier for endgame PvE by @TheAegisRelic Endgame Analysis Spreadsheet​, who says "probably best overall auto archetype accounting for barrier intrinsic and damage profile". The frame intrinsic offers built in Anti-Barrier, but offers no bonuses beyond being "well-rounded, reliable and sturdy" as per the Destiny Data Compendium. The recoil direction is vertical and loose so you could improve Recoil Direction or look to boost Stability with the barrel perk to help hit crits, or Handling if you can land your shots. In the magazine perk slot, the combat effect perks work well, or look for perks that improve mag size or Reload Speed. In the first trait perk column, Rewind Rounds refills 70% of hits landed from reserves when the magazine empties. To pair with that in the second column for damage, Onslaught, while not boosting damage per shot does increase raw DPS as you ramp up to the max ×3 stacks, for a refreshable 5s per kill, to increase RPM from 600 to around max 960, or Target Lock stacks up to 5 times on repeated hits within 0.2s of each other, for up to ×1.4 damage at 110.33% of base magazine capacity. If you're interested, "VS" is the designation for Vesper Station, and "pyroelectric" describes the property of materials which generate a temporary electrical voltage when they're heated or cooled. // Seventh Seraph Carbine - PvE Utility god 1
// (Fluted Barrel, Arrowhead Brake, Corkscrew Rifling, Polygonal Rifling, Smallbore, Hammer-Forged Rifling), (Seraph Rounds, Tactical Mag Appended Mag, Alloy Mag, Flared Magwell), (Attrition Orbs, Stopping Power), (Kinetic Tremors)
//notes:Constructed by @Adamsdown_Boy (PvE PvE-Utility PvE-Minor PvE-Champion PvE-GroupAdd PvE-EndGame PvE-God M+KB Controller): First-choice PvE roll for both dealing with Barrier Champions and clearing groups of Minor adds in activities rated Normal, Hard or Very Hard difficulty. Seventh Seraph Carbine is a precision auto rifle, which are rated C-Tier for endgame PvE by @TheAegisRelic Endgame Analysis Spreadsheet​, who says "worse damage profile than balanced, but has barrier intrinsic". The frame intrinsic offers built in Anti-Barrier, and a ×0.9 reduction in horizontal recoil, as per the Destiny Data Compendium. With the frame intrinsic, you don't really have to worry about Recoil Direction, so you can take your pick with the barrel perk to boost Handling, Stability or Range. In the magazine perk slot, Seraph Rounds is the clear stand-out, offering the benefits of High-Caliber, Armor-Piercing and Ricochet Rounds, otherwise perks that improve Reload Speed or mag size also work. Barrier champions are a little more difficult deal with at range in the final sandbox so, for a roll that can fill that role as well as help with dealing with Minor add groups, in the first trait perk column Attrition Orbs spawns a power orb after ~19 hits within 5s of each other to proc armour mods, or Stopping Power provides increased stagger, and increased damage on low health enemies - ×1.07 when health is below 34%, ×1.1 when <23% and ×1.15 when <18%. In the second column, Kinetic Tremors emits three 6m AoE Kinetic shockwaves after 11 hits within 3s of each other, which are treated as weapon damage so inherit damage boosts and also proc weapon effects like Attrition Orbs' orb generation. Aegis ranks the Rasputin's Arsenal origin trait as C-Tier for PvE - it refills 60% of your magazine on breaking an enemy shield or barrier, but it is useful on a weapon roll meant for a Barrier Champion. There's also the A-Tier Eyes Up, which is a bit inconsistent to proc, granting up to ×15 stacks to improve Range, Reload Speed and boost damage by a max ×1.05 after a kill when in combat for a 8s, extendable to 25s on further kills. If you're interested, the name reflects Bungie's deep-rooted obsession with religious symbolism and the number seven. In Christian theology, Seraphim are the highest order of angels who sit directly at the throne of God, traditionally described as celestial beings of pure fire with six wings. // Cusp Sempiternal - PvE Minor god 1
// (Full Bore, Hammer-Forged Rifling, Extended Barrel, Smallbore, Corkscrew Rifling), (Tactical Mag, Appended Mag, Alloy Mag, Flared Magwell, Light Mag), (Repulsor Brace), (Destabilizing Rounds)
//notes:Constructed by @Adamsdown_Boy (PvE PvE-Minor PvE-Utility PvE-GroupAdd PvE-God Void-Build M+KB Controller): First-choice PvE roll for clearing groups of Minor adds in activities rated Normal difficulty, particularly for Void builds. Cusp Sempiternal is a support-frame auto rifle, which are rated B-Tier for endgame PvE by @TheAegisRelic Endgame Analysis Spreadsheet​, who says "damage profile is serviceable, also has two niches in boosting damage and survivability". The frame intrinsic offers built in Anti-Overload, and it shoots tracking projectiles at enemies - any ability or weapon damage generates weapon energy that can be used when hipfiring at allies to heal them, with rapid healing also applying Amplified as per the Destiny Data Compendium. On Support Frames, the Range stat determines how far your bullets will travel before vanishing, so look for that with the barrel perk. In the magazine perk slot, look for perks that improve Range, mag size or Reload Speed. Physic isn't available, but for Void builds, you can get a ×0.5 damage resisting Void overshield with Repulsor Brace in the first trait perk column which lasts for 10s after killing a void-debuffed enemy - duration boosted by ×1.5 with Echo of Persistence. In the second column you can get that debuff through Destabilizing Rounds which spreads Void Volatility on a kill in a 6.5m radius and provides Volatile Rounds for 5.25s. Aegis ranks the Frame of Reference origin trait as A-Tier for PvE - it stacks up to ×5 times on kills, providing up to ×1.07 damage and boosts to Reload Speed and Range for 8s, with the timer pausing when the weapon's stowed. If you're interested, "Cusp" is a point of transition, a threshold, or a sharp apex where two curves meet, and "Sempiternal" translates from Latin to mean ever-lasting, continuous, or of never-ending duration within, rather than outside of time. This reflects the ultimate Vex goal of reaching the absolute threshold of time to cement a permanent, unalterable victory where they become a fundamental, everlasting law of the universe. //notes:Constructed by @Adamsdown_Boy (PvE PvE-Minor PvE-Utility PvE-GroupAdd PvE-EndGame PvE-God Void-Build M+KB Controller): First-choice PvE roll for clearing groups of Minor adds in activities rated Normal, Hard or Very Hard difficulty, particularly for Void builds. Cusp Sempiternal is a support-frame auto rifle, which are rated B-Tier for endgame PvE by @TheAegisRelic Endgame Analysis Spreadsheet​, who says "damage profile is serviceable, also has two niches in boosting damage and survivability". The frame intrinsic offers built in Anti-Overload, and it shoots tracking projectiles at enemies - any ability or weapon damage generates weapon energy that can be used when hipfiring at allies to heal them, with rapid healing also applying Amplified as per the Destiny Data Compendium. On Support Frames, the Range stat determines how far your bullets will travel before vanishing, so look for that with the barrel perk. In the magazine perk slot, look for perks that improve Range, mag size or Reload Speed. For Void build synergy and clearing Minor add groups, in the first column Attrition Orbs spawns a power orb after ~26 hits within 5s of each other, to proc armour mods or Reciprocity heals 3HP for each healing projectile that hits an ally. In the second column, Destabilizing Rounds spreads Void Volatility on a kill in a 6.5m radius and provides Volatile Rounds for 5.25s. Aegis ranks the Frame of Reference origin trait as A-Tier for PvE - it stacks up to ×5 times on kills, providing up to ×1.07 damage and boosts to Reload Speed and Range for 8s, with the timer pausing when the weapon's stowed. If you're interested, "Cusp" is a point of transition, a threshold, or a sharp apex where two curves meet, and "Sempiternal" translates from Latin to mean ever-lasting, continuous, or of never-ending duration within, rather than outside of, time. This reflects the ultimate Vex goal of reaching the absolute threshold of time to cement a permanent, unalterable victory where they become a fundamental, everlasting law of the universe. // Intercalary - PvE Minor god 1
// (Arrowhead Brake, Chambered Compensator, Extended Barrel, Fluted Barrel, Corkscrew Rifling, Polygonal Rifling, Smallbore, Hammer-Forged Rifling), (High-Caliber Rounds, Armor-Piercing Rounds, Ricochet Rounds, Appended Mag, Alloy Mag, Flared Magwell, Light Mag), (Headstone), (Rimestealer, Desperate Measures, Master of Arms)
//notes:Constructed by @Adamsdown_Boy (PvE PvE-Minor PvE-GroupAdd PvE-God Stasis-Build M+KB Controller): First-choice PvE roll for clearing groups of Minor adds in activities rated Normal difficulty, particularly for Stasis builds. Intercalary is an adaptive auto rifle, which are rated B-Tier for endgame PvE by @TheAegisRelic Endgame Analysis Spreadsheet​, who says "probably best overall auto archetype accounting for barrier intrinsic and damage profile". The frame intrinsic offers built in Anti-Barrier, but offers no bonuses beyond being "well-rounded, reliable and sturdy" as per the Destiny Data Compendium. The recoil direction is right of vertical and loose so you could improve Recoil Direction or look to boost Stability with the barrel perk to help hit crits, or Handling if you can land your shots. In the magazine perk slot, the combat effect perks work well, or look for perks that improve mag size or Reload Speed. For Stasis synergy, in the first trait perk column Headstone generates a Stasis crystal on a crit kill, these are weapon-generated entities so can inherit damage buffs, and proc weapon traits and subclass fragments when shattered for AoE damage. In the second column, for more Stasis synergy Rimestealer generates ×2 stacks of Stasis Frost Armor on shattering a Stasis crystal or killing a frozen enemy. Otherwise, for damage Desperate which Measures provides up to ×3 stacks for max ×1.3 damage for a refreshable 7.5s for a weapon and then two ability kills, or Master of Arms which provides ×1.15 damage for 8s after a kill with any weapon, with a second stack of ×1.25 for 5s on any kills with the first stack active. Aegis ranks the Frame of Reference origin trait as A-Tier for PvE - it stacks up to ×5 times on kills, providing up to ×1.07 damage and boosts to Reload Speed and Range for 8s, with the timer pausing when the weapon's stowed. If you're interested, the name is derived from the Latin intercalārius, combining inter ("between") and calāre ("to call out or proclaim"), and ties into Desert Perpetual's time-themed naming. An "intercalary day", better known as a leap day, is artificially inserted into a calendar to keep human timekeeping aligned with natural astronomical cycles. Recommended MW: Handling or Stability, with your preferred choice of mod to boost weapon stats, ammo generation, or elemental pickups for builds. |tags:PvE PvE-Minor PvE-GroupAdd PvE-God Stasis-Build M+KB Controller

// Intercalary - PvE Minor god 2
// (Arrowhead Brake, Chambered Compensator, Extended Barrel, Fluted Barrel, Corkscrew Rifling, Polygonal Rifling, Smallbore, Hammer-Forged Rifling), (High-Caliber Rounds, Armor-Piercing Rounds, Ricochet Rounds, Appended Mag, Alloy Mag, Flared Magwell, Light Mag), (Headstone), (One For All)
//notes:Constructed by @Adamsdown_Boy (PvE PvE-Minor PvE-GroupAdd PvE-EndGame PvE-God Stasis-Build M+KB Controller): First-choice PvE roll for clearing groups of Minor adds in activities rated Normal, Hard or Very Hard difficulty, particularly for Stasis builds. Intercalary is an adaptive auto rifle, which are rated B-Tier for endgame PvE by @TheAegisRelic Endgame Analysis Spreadsheet​, who says "probably best overall auto archetype accounting for barrier intrinsic and damage profile". The frame intrinsic offers built in Anti-Barrier, but offers no bonuses beyond being "well-rounded, reliable and sturdy" as per the Destiny Data Compendium. The recoil direction is right of vertical and loose so you could improve Recoil Direction or look to boost Stability with the barrel perk to help hit crits, or Handling if you can land your shots. In the magazine perk slot, the combat effect perks work well, or look for perks that improve mag size or Reload Speed. For Stasis synergy, in the first trait perk column Headstone generates a Stasis crystal on a crit kill, these are weapon-generated entities so can inherit damage buffs, and proc weapon traits and subclass fragments when shattered for AoE damage. In the second column, for straight damage there's One For All boosts damage by ×1.35 for a non-refreshable 11s after hitting three separate targets within 3s of each. Aegis ranks the Frame of Reference origin trait as A-Tier for PvE - it stacks up to ×5 times on kills, providing up to ×1.07 damage and boosts to Reload Speed and Range for 8s, with the timer pausing when the weapon's stowed. If you're interested, the name is derived from the Latin intercalārius, combining inter ("between") and calāre ("to call out or proclaim"), and ties into Desert Perpetual's time-themed naming. An "intercalary day", better known as a leap day, is artificially inserted into a calendar to keep human timekeeping aligned with natural astronomical cycles. Recommended MW: Handling or Stability, with your preferred choice of mod to boost weapon stats, ammo generation, or elemental pickups for builds. |tags:PvE PvE-Minor PvE-GroupAdd PvE-EndGame PvE-God Stasis-Build M+KB Controller

// Scathelocke - PvE Utility god 1
// (Arrowhead Brake, Chambered Compensator, Extended Barrel, Fluted Barrel, Corkscrew Rifling, Polygonal Rifling, Smallbore, Hammer-Forged Rifling), (Tactical Mag Appended Mag, Alloy Mag, Flared Magwell), (Attrition Orbs, Shoot to Loot), (Kinetic Tremors)
//notes:Constructed by @Adamsdown_Boy (PvE PvE-Utility PvE-Minor PvE-Champion PvE-GroupAdd PvE-EndGame PvE-God M+KB Controller): First-choice PvE roll for both dealing with Barrier Champions and clearing groups of Minor adds in activities rated Normal, Hard or Very Hard difficulty. Scathelocke is an adaptive auto rifle, which are rated B-Tier for endgame PvE by @TheAegisRelic Endgame Analysis Spreadsheet​, who says "probably best overall auto archetype accounting for barrier intrinsic and damage profile". The frame intrinsic offers built in Anti-Barrier, but offers no bonuses beyond being "well-rounded, reliable and sturdy" as per the Destiny Data Compendium. The recoil direction is right of vertical and loose so you could improve Recoil Direction or look to boost Stability with the barrel perk to help hit crits, or Handling if you can land your shots. In the magazine perk slot, look for perks that improve mag size or Reload Speed. Barrier Champions are a little more difficult deal with at range in the final sandbox so, for a roll that can fill that role as well as help with dealing with Minor add groups, in the first trait perk column Attrition Orbs spawns a power orb after ~19 hits within 5s of each other to proc armour mods, or Shoot to Loot lets you pick up remote ammo bricks or orbs from safety by shooting them, which also reloads all your weapons from reserves. In the second column, Kinetic Tremors emits three 6m AoE Kinetic shockwaves after 11 hits within 3s of each other, which are treated as weapon damage so inherit damage boosts and also proc weapon effects like Attrition Orbs' orb generation and Shoot to Loot's ammo and orb pickup. Aegis ranks the Veteran's Wisdom origin trait as S-Tier for PvE - it procs on a crit kill or 3 kills within 3s of each other to generate an 9m AoE kinetic shockwave which inflicts Exhaust on enemies. There's also the C-Tier Field Tested, which starts subtly but if you can stay alive to get hits and kills, you'll start to feel the boosts to Range, Stability, Handling and Reload Speed as you get to the higher stacks. If you're interested, Scathelocke is an alternate name for Will Scarlet, one of Robin Hood's legendary "Merry Men" in English folklore. It's a compound of the Old Norse/ Middle English word "scathe" (meaning to injure, harm, or obliterate) and "lock" (as in a lock of hair). Historically, this surname was often given as a nickname to an aggressive fighter or an incompetent barber. Recommended MW: Handling or Stability, with your preferred choice of mod to boost weapon stats, ammo generation, or elemental pickups for builds. |tags:PvE PvE-Utility PvE-Minor PvE-Champion PvE-GroupAdd PvE-EndGame PvE-God M+KB Controller

// Positive Outlook - PvE Minor god 1
// (Fluted Barrel, Arrowhead Brake, Corkscrew Rifling, Polygonal Rifling, Smallbore, Hammer-Forged Rifling), (High-Caliber Rounds, Armor-Piercing Rounds, Ricochet Rounds, Appended Mag, Alloy Mag, Flared Magwell, Light Mag), (Subsistence, Ambitious Assassin), (Mega Kill Clip)
//notes:Constructed by @Adamsdown_Boy (PvE PvE-Minor PvE-SingleAdd PvE-God Arc-Build M+KB Controller): First-choice PvE roll for clearing individual Minor adds or tougher enemies in activities rated Normal difficulty. Positive Outlook is a precision auto rifle, which are rated C-Tier for endgame PvE by @TheAegisRelic Endgame Analysis Spreadsheet​, who says "worse damage profile than balanced, but has barrier intrinsic". The frame intrinsic offers built in Anti-Barrier, and a ×0.9 reduction in horizontal recoil, as per the Destiny Data Compendium. With the frame intrinsic, you don't really have to worry about Recoil Direction, so you can take your pick with the barrel perk to boost Handling, Stability or Range. In the magazine perk slot, the combat effect perks work well, or look for perks that improve mag size or Reload Speed. Building into Mega Kill Clip in the second trait perk column, which boosts damage by ×1.4 with a duration of 3s + (2s × the number of kills) up to a max 20s, on finishing a reload within 5s of a kill, look for traits that overflow your mag or delay the need to reload. In the first column, look for Subsistence which reloads 20% of the magazine on kills, or Ambitious Assassin which builds up to ×15 stacks on kills within 8s of each other - on reload, each stack overflows 10% of the magazine, so at max stacks that's ×2.5 base capacity, rounding up. If you're lucky you'll drop a shiny version with Accelerated Assault origin trait, which Aegis ranks as S-Tier for PvE - it passively refills 10% of the magazine, and boosts damage by ×1.05 for getting 3 hits within a 1.6s window to delay reloads further. If you don't get a shiny drop, there's the B-Tier Vanguard Determination which provides up to ×3 stacks of damage resistance to max 6% - that's ×0.94 incoming damage - for a refreshable 12.5s, on kills within 20s of using a class ability. Alternatively there's the D-Tier Omolon Fluid Dynamics, which boosts Stability by up to +20 and Reload Speed by up to +30 in the top half of the mag, decreasing linearly until the mag's at 50%. // Positive Outlook - PvE Minor god 1
// (Fluted Barrel, Arrowhead Brake, Corkscrew Rifling, Polygonal Rifling, Smallbore, Hammer-Forged Rifling), (High-Caliber Rounds, Armor-Piercing Rounds, Ricochet Rounds, Appended Mag, Alloy Mag, Flared Magwell, Light Mag), (Subsistence, Ambitious Assassin), (Mega Kill Clip)
//notes:Constructed by @Adamsdown_Boy (PvE PvE-Minor PvE-SingleAdd PvE-God Arc-Build M+KB Controller): First-choice PvE roll for clearing individual Minor adds or tougher enemies in activities rated Normal difficulty. Positive Outlook is a precision auto rifle, which are rated C-Tier for endgame PvE by @TheAegisRelic Endgame Analysis Spreadsheet​, who says "worse damage profile than balanced, but has barrier intrinsic". The frame intrinsic offers built in Anti-Barrier, and a ×0.9 reduction in horizontal recoil, as per the Destiny Data Compendium. With the frame intrinsic, you don't really have to worry about Recoil Direction, so you can take your pick with the barrel perk to boost Handling, Stability or Range. In the magazine perk slot, the combat effect perks work well, or look for perks that improve mag size or Reload Speed. Building into Mega Kill Clip in the second trait perk column, which boosts damage by ×1.4 with a duration of 3s + (2s × the number of kills) up to a max 20s, on finishing a reload within 5s of a kill, look for traits that overflow your mag or delay the need to reload. In the first column, look for Subsistence reloads 20% of the magazine on kills, or Ambitious Assassin which builds up to ×15 stacks on kills within 8s of each other - on reload, each stack overflows 10% of the magazine, so at max stacks that's ×2.5 base capacity, rounding up. If you're lucky you'll drop a shiny version with Accelerated Assault origin trait, which Aegis ranks as S-Tier for PvE - it passively refills 10% of the magazine, and boosts damage by ×1.05 for getting 3 hits within a 1.6s window to delay reloads further. If you don't get a shiny drop, there's the B-Tier Vanguard Determination which provides up to ×3 stacks of damage resistance to max 6% - that's ×0.94 incoming damage - for a refreshable 12.5s, on kills within 20s of using a class ability. Alternatively there's the D-Tier Omolon Fluid Dynamics, which boosts Stability by up to +20 and Reload Speed by up to +30 in the top half of the mag, decreasing linearly until the mag's at 50%. Recommended MW: Handling or Stability, with your preferred choice of mod to boost weapon stats, ammo generation, or elemental pickups for builds. |tags:PvE PvE-Minor PvE-SingleAdd PvE-God Arc-Build M+KB Controller

// Veiled Threat - PvE Minor god 1
// (Arrowhead Brake, Chambered Compensator, Extended Barrel, Fluted Barrel, Corkscrew Rifling, Polygonal Rifling, Smallbore, Hammer-Forged Rifling), (Tactical Mag, Appended Mag, Alloy Mag, Flared Magwell, Light Mag), (Shoot to Loot, Attrition Orbs), (Headstone)
//notes:Constructed by @Adamsdown_Boy (PvE PvE-Minor PvE-GroupAdd PvE-EndGame PvE-God Stasis-Build M+KB Controller): First-choice PvE roll for clearing groups of Minor adds in activities rated Normal, Hard or Very Hard difficulty, particularly with Stasis builds. Veiled Threat is a rapid-fire auto rifle, which are rated C-Tier for endgame PvE by @TheAegisRelic Endgame Analysis Spreadsheet​, who says "solid damage profile but a strict step down compared to adaptive in same range tier". The frame intrinsic offers built in Anti-Overload, better total ammo reserves and a ×0.8 reload animation scalar when the magazine is empty as per the Destiny Data Compendium. The recoil direction is vertical and very loose so you could improve Recoil Direction or look to boost Stability with the barrel perk to help hit crits, or Handling if you can land your shots. In the magazine perk slot look for perks that improve mag size or Reload Speed. For Stasis builds, in the first trait perk column Shoot to Loot lets you pick up remote ammo bricks or orbs from safety by shooting them, which also reloads all your weapons from reserves or Attrition Orbs spawns a power orb after 11 hits within 5s of each other to proc armour mods. In the second column Headstone generates a Stasis crystal on a crit kill, these are weapon-generated entities so can inherit damage buffs, and proc weapon traits like Attrition Orbs and subclass fragments when shattered for AoE damage. Aegis ranks the Radiolaria Transposer origin trait as A-Tier for PvE - it's useful for clearing adds - three Minors or one Major or Boss enemy kill will result in a 3m AoE explosion on death, leaving a damaging pool of radiolaria for a few seconds. The damage is treated as weapon damage so inherits damage boosts and also procs weapon effects like Attrition Orbs' orb generation or picking up ammo bricks and power orbs with Shoot to Loot. If you're interested, the name serves as a double entendre, referring to a hidden or disguised danger but also evoking the Veil. It was introduced during Episode: Echoes alongside a mission named Veiled Threats (where Sol Divisive Vex attempt to exploit a lingering connection to the Veil) - the name highlights a lingering, hidden malice that persists even after the Witness's defeat. Recommended MW: Handling or Stability, with your preferred choice of mod to boost weapon stats, ammo generation, or elemental pickups for builds. |tags:PvE PvE-Minor PvE-GroupAdd PvE-EndGame PvE-God Stasis-Build M+KB Controller

// Reckless Oracle - PvE Minor god 1
// (Arrowhead Brake, Chambered Compensator, Extended Barrel, Fluted Barrel, Corkscrew Rifling, Polygonal Rifling, Smallbore, Hammer-Forged Rifling), (High-Caliber Rounds, Armor-Piercing Rounds, Ricochet Rounds, Appended Mag, Alloy Mag, Flared Magwell, Light Mag), (Dimensional Shift), (Withering Gaze)
//notes:Constructed by @Adamsdown_Boy (PvE PvE-Minor PvE-SingleAdd PvE-EndGame PvE-God Void-Build M+KB Controller): First-choice PvE roll for clearing individual Minor adds or tougher enemies in activities rated Normal, Hard or Very Hard difficulty, particularly with Void builds. Reckless Oracle is a rapid-fire auto rifle, which are rated C-Tier for endgame PvE by @TheAegisRelic Endgame Analysis Spreadsheet​, who says "solid damage profile but a strict step down compared to adaptive in same range tier". The frame intrinsic offers built in Anti-Overload, better total ammo reserves and a ×0.8 reload animation scalar when the magazine is empty as per the Destiny Data Compendium. The recoil direction is right of vertical and loose so you could improve Recoil Direction or look to boost Stability with the barrel perk to help hit crits, or Handling if you can land your shots. In the magazine perk slot, the combat effect perks work well, or look for perks that improve mag size or Reload Speed. For Void builds, Dimensional Shift grants Dimensional Breach on picking up a Void Breach which, while active provides a refreshable 8s overshield on kills. You can use Withering Gaze in the second column with Echoes of Harvest and Starvation to continuously proc Devour by applying the Void Weaken debuff to targets after ADS-ing for 1.3s for ×1.15 damage for a refreshable 6s. If the stronger ×1.3 weaken has been applied from Tractor Cannon or Shadowshot, a proc will handily reapply at the higher value. Aegis ranks the Elliptical Orbit origin trait as A-Tier for PvE - it passively grants Inner Orbit, boosting Stability, Reload Speed and Flinch Resist, which changes to Outer Orbit for a refreshable 3s after sprinting for 1.5s which significantly boosts Ammo Generation. There's also the very handy B-Tier Photoinhibition which is excellent in PvE, boosting shield, overshield and barrier damage, disorienting for 5s on a shield break, and AoE disorienting enemies in a 5m radius on a matching Void shield break. If you're interested, the name draws a parallel between the Vex's fatalistic timeline-weaving mechanics and the tragic hubris of the Kentarch 3 - a fireteam of Guardians who accepted Dark powers within the Black Garden, representing the dangerous folly of pursuing forbidden, absolute knowledge while actively accelerating toward a grim, predetermined fate. Recommended MW: Handling or Stability, with your preferred choice of mod to boost weapon stats, ammo generation, or elemental pickups for builds. |tags:PvE PvE-Minor PvE-SingleAdd PvE-EndGame PvE-God Strand-Build M+KB Controller

// Reckless Oracle - PvE Minor god 2
// (Arrowhead Brake, Chambered Compensator, Extended Barrel, Fluted Barrel, Corkscrew Rifling, Polygonal Rifling, Smallbore, Hammer-Forged Rifling), (High-Caliber Rounds, Armor-Piercing Rounds, Ricochet Rounds, Appended Mag, Alloy Mag, Flared Magwell, Light Mag), (Collective Demolition, Fourth Time's the Charm), (One For All, Chaos Reshaped)
//notes:Constructed by @Adamsdown_Boy (PvE PvE-Minor PvE-SingleAdd PvE-EndGame PvE-God Void-Build M+KB Controller): First-choice PvE roll for clearing individual Minor adds or tougher enemies in activities rated Normal, Hard or Very Hard difficulty. In the magazine perk slot, the combat effect perks work well, or look for perks that improve mag size or Reload Speed. For a general purpose roll for clearing tougher Minor adds, in the first trait perk column Collective Demolition synergises with grenade builds by providing grenade ability energy on hits after interacting with an elemental pickup - Firesprites and Void Breaches for 8s, Ionic Traces, Stasis Shards for 4s and Strand Tangles and Arc Elemental Orbs 4s each for pickup and explosion when thrown. Otherwise Fourth Time's the Charm generates 2 shots from thin air after 4 crits within 3s of each other, delaying the need to reload and almost doubling mag size if you can keep hitting crits. In the second column, for damage, One For All boosts damage by ×1.35 for a non-refreshable 11s after hitting three separate targets within 3s of each or Chaos Reshaped stacks up to ×2 on dealing or receiving damage within a 5s window for at least 11.5s - at ×1 it provides a ×1.2 damage boost for a refreshable 7s and then at ×2 provides ×1.35 damage for a refreshable 7s together with a healing burst of up to 35HP that also starts health regeneration - although this is bugged, so while it's active it interrupts natural recovery and prevents regenerating the final 20-25% of your health bar. Aegis ranks the Elliptical Orbit origin trait as A-Tier for PvE - it passively grants Inner Orbit, boosting Stability, Reload Speed and Flinch Resist, which changes to Outer Orbit for a refreshable 3s after sprinting for 1.5s which significantly boosts Ammo Generation. If you're interested, the name draws a parallel between the Vex's fatalistic timeline-weaving mechanics and the tragic hubris of the Kentarch 3 - a fireteam of Guardians who accepted Dark powers within the Black Garden, representing the dangerous folly of pursuing forbidden, absolute knowledge while actively accelerating toward a grim, predetermined fate. // Reckless Oracle - PvE Minor god 1
// (Arrowhead Brake, Chambered Compensator, Extended Barrel, Fluted Barrel, Corkscrew Rifling, Polygonal Rifling, Smallbore, Hammer-Forged Rifling), (High-Caliber Rounds, Armor-Piercing Rounds, Ricochet Rounds, Appended Mag, Alloy Mag, Flared Magwell, Light Mag), (Dimensional Shift), (Withering Gaze)
//notes:Constructed by @Adamsdown_Boy (PvE PvE-Minor PvE-SingleAdd PvE-EndGame PvE-God Void-Build M+KB Controller): First-choice PvE roll for clearing individual Minor adds or tougher enemies in activities rated Normal, Hard or Very Hard difficulty, particularly with Void builds. Reckless Oracle is a rapid-fire auto rifle, which are rated C-Tier for endgame PvE by @TheAegisRelic Endgame Analysis Spreadsheet​, who says "solid damage profile but a strict step down compared to adaptive in same range tier". The frame intrinsic offers built in Anti-Overload, better total ammo reserves and a ×0.8 reload animation scalar when the magazine is empty as per the Destiny Data Compendium. The recoil direction is right of vertical and loose so you could improve Recoil Direction or look to boost Stability with the barrel perk to help hit crits, or Handling if you can land your shots. In the magazine perk slot, the combat effect perks work well, or look for perks that improve mag size or Reload Speed. For Void builds, Dimensional Shift grants Dimensional Breach on picking up a Void Breach which, while active provides a refreshable 8s overshield on kills. You can use Withering Gaze in the second column with Echoes of Harvest and Starvation to continuously proc Devour by applying the Void Weaken debuff to targets after ADS-ing for 1.3s for ×1.15 damage for a refreshable 6s. If the stronger ×1.3 weaken has been applied from Tractor Cannon or Shadowshot, a proc will handily reapply at the higher value. Aegis ranks the Elliptical Orbit origin trait as A-Tier for PvE - it passively grants Inner Orbit, boosting Stability, Reload Speed and Flinch Resist, which changes to Outer Orbit for a refreshable 3s after sprinting for 1.5s which significantly boosts Ammo Generation. There's also the very handy B-Tier Photoinhibition which is excellent in PvE, boosting shield, overshield and barrier damage, disorienting for 5s on a shield break, and AoE disorienting enemies in a 5m radius on a matching Void shield break. If you're interested, the name draws a parallel between the Vex's fatalistic timeline-weaving mechanics and the tragic hubris of the Kentarch 3 - a fireteam of Guardians who accepted Dark powers within the Black Garden, representing the dangerous folly of pursuing forbidden, absolute knowledge while actively accelerating toward a grim, predetermined fate. Recommended MW: Handling or Stability, with your preferred choice of mod to boost weapon stats, ammo generation, or elemental pickups for builds. |tags:PvE PvE-Minor PvE-SingleAdd PvE-EndGame PvE-God Strand-Build M+KB Controller

// Reckless Oracle - PvE Minor god 2
// (Arrowhead Brake, Chambered Compensator, Extended Barrel, Fluted Barrel, Corkscrew Rifling, Polygonal Rifling, Smallbore, Hammer-Forged Rifling), (High-Caliber Rounds, Armor-Piercing Rounds, Ricochet Rounds, Appended Mag, Alloy Mag, Flared Magwell, Light Mag), (Collective Demolition, Fourth Time's the Charm), (One For All, Chaos Reshaped)
//notes:Constructed by @Adamsdown_Boy (PvE PvE-Minor PvE-SingleAdd PvE-EndGame PvE-God Void-Build M+KB Controller): First-choice PvE roll for clearing individual Minor adds or tougher enemies in activities rated Normal, Hard or Very Hard difficulty. Reckless Oracle is a rapid-fire auto rifle, which are rated C-Tier for endgame PvE by @TheAegisRelic Endgame Analysis Spreadsheet​, who says "solid damage profile but a strict step down compared to adaptive in same range tier". The frame intrinsic offers built in Anti-Overload, better total ammo reserves and a ×0.8 reload animation scalar when the magazine is empty as per the Destiny Data Compendium. The recoil direction is right of vertical and loose so you could improve Recoil Direction or look to boost Stability with the barrel perk to help hit crits, or Handling if you can land your shots. In the magazine perk slot, the combat effect perks work well, or look for perks that improve mag size or Reload Speed. For a general purpose roll for clearing tougher Minor adds, in the first trait perk column Collective Demolition synergises with grenade builds by providing grenade ability energy on hits after interacting with an elemental pickup - Firesprites and Void Breaches for 8s, Ionic Traces, Stasis Shards for 4s and Strand Tangles and Arc Elemental Orbs 4s each for pickup and explosion when thrown. Otherwise Fourth Time's the Charm generates 2 shots from thin air after 4 crits within 3s of each other, delaying the need to reload and almost doubling mag size if you can keep hitting crits. In the second column, for damage, One For All boosts damage by ×1.35 for a non-refreshable 11s after hitting three separate targets within 3s of each or Chaos Reshaped stacks up to ×2 on dealing or receiving damage within a 5s window for at least 11.5s - at ×1 it provides a ×1.2 damage boost for a refreshable 7s and then at ×2 provides ×1.35 damage for a refreshable 7s together with a healing burst of up to 35HP that also starts health regeneration - although this is bugged, so while it's active it interrupts natural recovery and prevents regenerating the final 20-25% of your health bar. Aegis ranks the Elliptical Orbit origin trait as A-Tier for PvE - it passively grants Inner Orbit, boosting Stability, Reload Speed and Flinch Resist, which changes to Outer Orbit for a refreshable 3s after sprinting for 1.5s which significantly boosts Ammo Generation. There's also the very handy B-Tier Photoinhibition which is excellent in PvE, boosting shield, overshield and barrier damage, disorienting for 5s on a shield break, and AoE disorienting enemies in a 5m radius on a matching Void shield break. If you're interested, the name draws a parallel between the Vex's fatalistic timeline-weaving mechanics and the tragic hubris of the Kentarch 3 - a fireteam of Guardians who accepted Dark powers within the Black Garden, representing the dangerous folly of pursuing forbidden, absolute knowledge while actively accelerating toward a grim, predetermined fate. Recommended MW: Handling or Stability, with your preferred choice of mod to boost weapon stats, ammo generation, or elemental pickups for builds. |tags:PvE PvE-Minor PvE-SingleAdd PvE-EndGame PvE-God Strand-Build M+KB Controller

// The Ringing Nail - PvE Minors god 1
// (Fluted Barrel, Arrowhead Brake, Corkscrew Rifling, Polygonal Rifling, Smallbore, Hammer-Forged Rifling), (High-Caliber Rounds, Armor-Piercing Rounds, Ricochet Rounds, Appended Mag, Alloy Mag, Flared Magwell, Light Mag), (Incandescent), (Burning Ambition)
//notes:Constructed by @Adamsdown_Boy (PvE PvE-Minor PvE-GroupAdd PvE-EndGame PvE-God Solar-Build M+KB Controller): First-choice PvE roll for clearing clearing groups of Minor adds in activities rated Normal, Hard or Very Hard difficulty, particularly with Solar builds. The Ringing Nail is a precision auto rifle, which are rated C-Tier for endgame PvE by @TheAegisRelic Endgame Analysis Spreadsheet​, who says "worse damage profile than balanced, but has barrier intrinsic". The frame intrinsic offers built in Anti-Barrier, and a ×0.9 reduction in horizontal recoil, as per the Destiny Data Compendium. With the frame intrinsic, you don't really have to worry about Recoil Direction, so you can take your pick with the barrel perk to boost Handling, Stability or Range. In the magazine perk slot, the combat effect perks work well, or look for perks that improve mag size or Reload Speed. For a roll to clear both group and tougher individual adds, and which also synergises with Solar builds - In the first trait perk column, Incandescent spreads +30 Solar Scorch stacks within 4m on a red bar Minor add kill (+45 stacks within 8m for orange and yellow bars), with scorch damage counting as weapon damage so can inherit damage boosts, and also proc subclass fragments. In the second, you can use a scorch ability to make the most of Burning Ambition to build Solar ignitions on tougher targets. If you can't apply scorch first, it'll take ~19 hits within 2s of each other to apply +10 scorch stacks, with +10 added on each additional hit afterwards to build towards an ignition. All of the scorch stacks for both perks are increased by ×1.5 with Ember of Ashes. Aegis ranks the Forge's Kin origin trait as S-Tier for PvE - it provides a ×1 stack of "Forge's Kin" for 5s after a kill, or on swapping from another Black Armory weapon kill within 7s. Each additional Black Armory weapon equipped adds an additional stack, each boosting the activation window by +2s together with increasing Reload Speed and Ammo Generation, and applying damage boosts of ×1.1 for one or ×1.13 for two. If you're interested, the name is drawn from from the traditional art of blacksmithing and metallurgy. The phrase literally refers to the distinct, high-pitched acoustic resonance (the "ringing") produced when a blacksmith strikes a high-quality, hot metal nail or anvil with a hammer. Recommended MW: Handling or Stability, with your preferred choice of mod to boost weapon stats, ammo generation, or elemental pickups for builds. |tags:PvE PvE-Minor PvE-GroupAdd PvE-EndGame PvE-God Solar-Build M+KB Controller

// The Ringing Nail - PvE Minors god 2
// (Fluted Barrel, Arrowhead Brake, Corkscrew Rifling, Polygonal Rifling, Smallbore, Hammer-Forged Rifling), (High-Caliber Rounds, Armor-Piercing Rounds, Ricochet Rounds, Appended Mag, Alloy Mag, Flared Magwell, Light Mag), (Incandescent), (Firefly, Onslaught)
//notes:Constructed by @Adamsdown_Boy (PvE PvE-Minor PvE-GroupAdd PvE-God Solar-Build M+KB Controller): First-choice PvE roll for clearing clearing groups of Minor adds in activities rated Normal difficulty, particularly with Solar builds. The Ringing Nail is a precision auto rifle, which are rated C-Tier for endgame PvE by @TheAegisRelic Endgame Analysis Spreadsheet​, who says "worse damage profile than balanced, but has barrier intrinsic". The frame intrinsic offers built in Anti-Barrier, and a ×0.9 reduction in horizontal recoil, as per the Destiny Data Compendium. With the frame intrinsic, you don't really have to worry about Recoil Direction, so you can take your pick with the barrel perk to boost Handling, Stability or Range. In the magazine perk slot, the combat effect perks work well, or look for perks that improve mag size or Reload Speed. For a double damage roll to clear add groups, and which also synergises with Solar builds in the first trait perk column, Incandescent spreads +30 Solar Scorch stacks within 4m on a red bar Minor add kill (+45 stacks within 8m for orange and yellow bars), with scorch damage counting as weapon damage so can inherit damage boosts, and also proc subclass fragments. All of the scorch stacks for both perks are increased by ×1.5 with Ember of Ashes. In the second column, Firefly procs a 4m AoE Solar explosion on a crit kill which will spread Incandescent scorch stacks further, plus +50 Reload Speed for 6s - this also counts as weapon damage so can inherit damage boosts, and proc subclass fragments. Alternatively, Onslaught, while not boosting damage per shot does increase raw DPS as you ramp up to the max ×3 stacks, for a refreshable 5s per kill, to increase RPM from 450 to around max 720. Aegis ranks the Forge's Kin origin trait as S-Tier for PvE - it provides a ×1 stack of "Forge's Kin" for 5s after a kill, or on swapping from another Black Armory weapon kill within 7s. Each additional Black Armory weapon equipped adds an additional stack, each boosting the activation window by +2s together with increasing Reload Speed and Ammo Generation, and applying damage boosts of ×1.1 for one or ×1.13 for two. If you're interested, the name is drawn from from the traditional art of blacksmithing and metallurgy. The phrase literally refers to the distinct, high-pitched acoustic resonance (the "ringing") produced when a blacksmith strikes a high-quality, hot metal nail or anvil with a hammer.
